The Chhattisgarh Public Service Commission (CGPSC) has released the CGPSC State Service Mains Result 2026 for candidates who appeared in the Mains Examination held from 6th to 9th June 2026. The exam was conducted under the CGPSC State Service Examination (SSE) 2025-26 recruitment cycle for Group A and Group B posts such as Deputy Collector, Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP), and Naib Tehsildar. Candidates can now check their qualifying status, download their scorecard, and view the CGPSC interview dates through the official result portal at psc.cg.gov.in.

Important Dates for CGPSC Mains Result 2026

  • CGPSC SSE Prelims Exam: 22nd February 2026
  • CGPSC Prelims Result: 25th March 2026
  • CGPSC Mains Exam (originally scheduled): 16th–19th May 2026
  • CGPSC Mains Exam (as actually held, after postponement): 6th–9th June 2026
  • CGPSC Mains Result Declared: 31st August 2026
  • CGPSC Interview / Personality Test: 21st September 2026 onwards

CGPSC Mains Results 2026: How to Download the PDF

The direct result/merit list link is active on the official CGPSC portal. Candidates can download the shortlist PDF containing roll numbers of qualified applicants and can also view their individual scorecards after logging in.

Steps to Check CGPSC Mains Result 2026

  1. Visit the official website at psc.cg.gov.in.
  2. Click on the "CGPSC State Service Mains 2026 Result" link on the homepage.
  3. Open the result login page.
  4. Enter your Roll Number / Application Number and Password or Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the security captcha and click Submit.
  6. View your result and scorecard on screen.
  7. Download and print the CGPSC Mains 2026 result PDF/scorecard for future reference.

CGPSC Mains Score Card 2026: What It Contains

The scorecard shows performance across all descriptive papers Language, Essay, and General Studies I to V. Candidates should take multiple printouts, as it is required at the interview and document verification stages.

  • Candidate's Full Name
  • Roll Number & Application Number
  • Category & Sub-Category (UR / OBC / SC / ST / EWS / PwD)
  • Domicile Status (Chhattisgarh Domicile / Other State)
  • Paper-wise Marks Obtained (Paper I to Paper VII)
  • Total Score Obtained (out of 1,400)
  • Category Cut-Off Score
  • Final Selection Status for Interview / Personality Test

Also Read: SSC Stenographer City Intimation Slip 2026

CGPSC Mains Qualifying Marks & Cut Off 2026

Category Minimum Qualifying Percentage Minimum Qualifying Marks (Out of 1,400)
General / Unreserved (UR) 33% Aggregate 462 Marks
Economically Weaker Section (EWS) 33% Aggregate 462 Marks
Scheduled Caste (SC) 23% Aggregate 322 Marks
Scheduled Tribe (ST) 23% Aggregate 322 Marks
Other Backward Classes (OBC) 23% Aggregate 322 Marks
Persons with Disabilities (PwD) 23% Aggregate 322 Marks

Documents Required for CGPSC Document Verification

Candidates called for the Interview and Document Verification stage should keep the following ready (exact list to be confirmed via the official interview call letter):

  • CGPSC Mains admit card and scorecard printouts
  • Educational qualification certificates and mark sheets
  • Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/EWS), where applicable
  • Domicile / residence certificate
  • Age proof (birth certificate / 10th mark sheet)
  • Valid photo identification (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, etc.)
  • Recent passport-size photographs

Also Read: NTPC Assistant Chemist Trainee Exam Date 2026

What's Next After CGPSC Mains Result 2026?

  • Interview / Personality Test: Carries 150 marks and assesses personal suitability for state administrative services. Scheduled from 21st September 2026 onwards.
  • Document Verification: Verification of educational certificates, age proof, domicile status, caste certificates, and identification documents.
  • Medical Examination: Candidates must meet physical standards and medical fitness criteria for executive posts like DSP, Assistant Jail Superintendent, and District Excise Officer.
  • Final Merit List & Appointment: Prepared on combined marks of Mains (1,400) and Interview (150), i.e. out of 1,550 total marks.

Important Instructions

  • Reported total vacancy figures for this cycle vary between 238 and 239 across sources confirm the exact number from the official notification PDF.
  • The Mains exam date changed from an originally scheduled 16–19 May 2026 window to 6–9 June 2026 due to postponement always check the latest notice on psc.cg.gov.in for any further schedule changes.
  • Keep Roll Number/Application Number and Date of Birth/Password ready before attempting result login to avoid delays.
  • Download and safely store multiple copies of the scorecard, as it will be required at later stages.
  • The exact release date/time for the interview call letters and any updated interview schedule has not been separately confirmed and should be tracked on the official website.

What the PNB LBO Score Card 2026 Contains

The individual scorecard is a diagnostic document distinct from the result PDF. It is issued to candidates who appeared in the online written test, regardless of whether they ultimately qualified. It typically displays:

  • Candidate's roll number and registration number
  • Section-wise marks scored in the online written examination
  • Overall/aggregate marks
  • Qualifying status (Qualified / Not Qualified) for that stage

How to Download PNB LBO Score Card 2026

  1. Visit the official PNB recruitment page at pnb.bank.in, or go directly to the ibpsreg.ibps.in scorecard login portal.
  2. Locate the notice titled "Link to View Individual Scorecard" under the Local Bank Officer recruitment section.
  3. Enter your Registration Number / Application Number in the first field.
  4. Enter your Password, or your Date of Birth in DD-MM-YYYY format, in the second field.
  5. Click the Login/Submit button.
  6. Your section-wise scorecard will be displayed on screen.
  7. Download the PDF, or use Ctrl+P to save it as a PDF if no direct download option is shown.
  8. Take a printout and store it safely you will need it during document verification and joining formalities.

Central Bank of India Apprentice Selection Process

The engagement process for Central Bank of India Apprentices FY 2026-27 involved the following stages, as per the official notification:

  1. Online application (as per notification dated 11.06.2026)

Candidates must be between 20 and 28 years of age as on 31 May 2026, meaning they should be born between 31 May 1998 and 31 May 2006 (both dates inclusive).

Salary / Stipend Details

Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of ₹15,000 during the 12-month training period. This is a training stipend rather than a regular salary, and no other allowances or benefits are provided. Completion of the apprenticeship does not guarantee permanent employment with the bank.

Application Fee

The exact application fee amount for the CBI Apprentice Recruitment 2026 was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this article. Candidates should refer to the official Central Bank of India Apprentice notification PDF on centralbank.bank.in for accurate, category-wise fee details, since this cannot be reliably stated here.

Selection Process

The Central Bank of India Apprentice selection process involves two stages:

  1. Online Written Examination: An objective-type computer-based test with no negative marking for wrong answers.
  2. Local Language Proficiency Test: Candidates who qualify the online exam may need to appear for a test assessing reading, writing, and speaking skills in the local language of the applied state. Candidates who studied the local language at Class 10 or Class 12 level may be exempted from this test, subject to document verification.

Final selection also depends on document verification and meeting the required medical fitness standards set by the bank.

Documents Required at the Exam Centre

  • Printed copy of the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026
  • A valid original government-issued photo ID proof, such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence
  • A photocopy of the photo ID for verification
  • Recent passport-size photographs, as specified in the admit card instructions

Candidates should ensure the name on their ID proof matches the name printed on the admit card to avoid denial of entry.

How to Download the CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026

Follow these steps to download your Central Bank of India Apprentice hall ticket:

  1. Visit the official website of the Central Bank of India at centralbankofindia.co.in or centralbank.bank.in.
  2. Go to the "Recruitment" or "Careers" section on the homepage.
  3. Click on the "CBI Apprentice Admit Card 2026" or "Download Call Letter" link.
  4. Enter your Registration Number/Roll Number and Password or Date of Birth.
  5. Fill in the captcha code, if required.
  6. Click the Login or Submit button.
  7. Your CBI Apprentice Hall Ticket 2026 will appear on the screen.
  8. Carefully verify all details, including your name, photograph, signature, exam date, and exam centre.
  9. Download the admit card and take a clear printout on an A4 sheet for the examination.

Central Bank of India Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026

The online written examination consists of 100 objective-type questions worth 100 marks, to be completed in 60 minutes, with no negative marking.

Quantitative & Reasoning Aptitude 20 20 English/Hindi

  • Carry the printed admit card; digital copies on a phone or tablet are typically not accepted.
  • Do not carry prohibited items such as mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, Bluetooth devices, bags, or study material into the exam hall.
  • Check your name, photograph, exam centre address, and category details on the admit card, and report any discrepancy to the helpdesk immediately.
  • Wear simple clothing and avoid accessories like jewellery or metal items, as per standard exam-day dress code guidelines followed by the bank.

RBI Grade B Phase 1 Admit Card 2026 - Released

The Phase 1 exam is qualifying in nature only scores from this stage are used solely to shortlist candidates for Phase 2 (Mains). Marks from Phase 1 do not contribute to the final merit list.

RBI Grade B Mains Admit Card 2026 - Expected in July

With Phase 1 completed, all attention now turns to the RBI Grade B Phase 2 Mains Admit Card 2026, which is expected to be released in July 2026, ahead of the Mains exam scheduled on 25th July 2026 for General posts and 26th July 2026 for DEPR/DSIM posts. RBI typically releases the Mains hall ticket approximately 7 to 10 days before the exam date, so candidates should watch the official website closely during the second week of July.

The Mains exam is a comprehensive paper that tests a candidate's knowledge of Economic and Social Issues, Finance and Management, and English Writing Skills. Unlike Phase 1, Phase 2 marks are directly counted in the final selection.

 

How to Download RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026

Downloading the RBI Grade B call letter is a straightforward process. The same steps apply for both Phase 1 (already released) and Phase 2 (upcoming). Follow the steps below to access your hall ticket from the official website.

Step 4: Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth / Password in the respective fields.

Step 5: Click on the Submit button. Your RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026 will be displayed on the screen.

Step 6: Carefully verify all the details printed on the call letter name, roll number, exam centre, and shift timing.

Step 7: Download and take at least 2 printouts to carry on exam day.

Step 8: Read all exam day instructions mentioned on the call letter before the examination.

Candidate's Name, Roll Number and Registration Number, Photograph and Signature, Date of Birth, Category (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD), Post Applied For, Exam Date and Shift Timing, Reporting Time and Gate Closing Time, Exam Centre Name, Address, and Code, and Important Exam Day Instructions.

Documents to Carry to the RBI Grade B Exam Centre

Carrying the right documents to the examination centre is mandatory. Entry will not be granted if the candidate fails to produce valid identity proof along with the printed admit card.

Every candidate must bring the following on exam day:

Printed copy of the RBI Grade B Admit Card 2026, 2 recent passport-size photographs, one valid original Photo ID proof such as Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Voter ID, or Driving Licence, and a photocopy of the same Photo ID.

RBI Grade B Exam Pattern 2026

Understanding the exam pattern helps candidates prepare effectively for both phases of the selection process. The RBI Grade B selection consists of Phase 1 (Prelims), Phase 2 (Mains), and an Interview round.

Phase 1 Exam Pattern - Objective Type (Qualifying)

Phase 1 is a 2-hour online objective exam carrying 200 marks across 200 questions. Since it is only qualifying, candidates must clear it to advance to Mains, but these marks do not count toward the final score.

RBI Grade B Exam Day Instructions 2026

RBI has issued specific instructions that every candidate must follow on exam day. Non-compliance may result in disqualification from the examination.

Candidates must reach the exam centre before the gate closing time without fail. Biometric verification including thumb impression and photograph capture will be conducted at the centre. Ensure your name on the admit card matches exactly with your photo ID. Wearing clothes with metal items, large buttons, or accessories that could trigger security checks should be avoided. Electronic devices including mobile phones, smart watches, Bluetooth devices, calculators, and books are strictly prohibited inside the examination hall. The exam centre and date allotted on the call letter are final no requests for change of centre, date, or session will be entertained.

The Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released the notification for the Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks, 15th cycle (CRP RRBs-XV), inviting online applications for Group "A" Officer (Scale-I, II & III) and Group "B" Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts across 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) in India. IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 online registration opens on 1 September 2026 and closes on 21 September 2026.

Quick answer: IBPS is recruiting for Officer Scale-I, II (seven specialisations), III, and Office Assistant (Multipurpose) posts, with an indicative 13,706 vacancies spread across 28 RRBs covering nearly every state and union territory of India. Graduates in any discipline (with specific additional qualifications for certain Officer Scale-II specialist roles) between 18 and 40 years of age (depending on the post) can apply online only, from 1 September 2026 to 21 September 2026, at the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in.

  • IBPS RRB CRP-XV Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
  • Direct link to apply for IBPS RRB CRP-XV Recruitment 2026
  • • Never Miss an Update from OnlyJobs – Save Us as a Preferred Source on Google

IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 Overview

Particulars Details
Recruiting Body Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS), on behalf of 28 Regional Rural Banks (RRBs)
Recruitment Name Common Recruitment Process for RRBs (CRP RRBs-XV)
Posts Office Assistant (Multipurpose); Officer Scale-I, II & III
Total Vacancies 13,706 (indicative; see Vacancy Details section)
Application Mode Online only
Application Start Date 01.09.2026
Last Date to Apply 21.09.2026
Job Location Regional Rural Banks across 28 States/UTs of India
Official Website www.ibps.in

IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

Activity Tentative Schedule
Online registration of application 01.09.2026 to 21.09.2026
Payment of application fee/intimation charges (online) 01.09.2026 to 21.09.2026
Edit window to modify/correct application form For 2 days after closure of registration (date to be notified on the official website)
Conduct of Pre-Exam Training (PET) November 2026
Call letter download - Preliminary exam (Officers/Office Assistant) November/December 2026
Online Examination - Preliminary (Officers/Office Assistant) November/December 2026
Result of Preliminary exam December 2026/January 2027
Call letter download - Main/Single exam December 2026/January 2027
Online Examination - Main/Single (Officers/Office Assistant) December 2026/February 2027
Declaration of result - Main/Single (Officer Scale I, II, III) January 2027
Call letter download - Interview (Officer Scale I, II, III) January 2027
Conduct of Interview (Officer Scale I, II, III) January/February 2027
Provisional Allotment (all posts) February/March 2027

IBPS RRB Vacancy 2026 - Post-Wise Details

IBPS has released indicative, RRB-wise and category-wise vacancies for each post in Annexure-I of the notification. The notification itself does not print a single consolidated grand-total figure; the totals below are computed by summing the individual state/RRB-wise tables for each post category. One participating bank, Tripura Gramin Bank, has reported "NR" (Not Reported) against every post, so it is excluded from these computed totals and the true final vacancy count will be higher once that figure is released.

S. No. Post Name No. of Posts (computed total, indicative)
1 Office Assistant (Multipurpose) 8,183
2 Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) 4,256
3 Officer Scale-II (all specialisations combined: General Banking Officer, IT Officer, Chartered Accountant, Law Officer, Treasury Manager, Marketing Officer, Agricultural Officer) 1,047
4 Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) 220
Total (computed, excluding Tripura Gramin Bank's "NR" figures) 13,706

Vacancies are spread across all 28 participating RRBs, covering states such as Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Gujarat, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and others. Candidates can check the RRB-wise, category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/General) breakup for their state directly in Annexure-I of the official notification, since a state/category-level reproduction is too extensive for this summary.

IBPS RRB Eligibility Criteria & Qualification

Nationality: a candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who arrived before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently in India, or a person of Indian origin migrated from certain specified countries with an eligibility certificate from the Government of India.

Educational qualification (as on the last date of online registration, i.e. 21.09.2026) varies by post:

Post Essential Educational Qualification Post-Qualification Experience
Office Assistant (Multipurpose) Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognised university or equivalent; proficiency in the local language prescribed by the participating RRB; working knowledge of computers is desirable Not required
Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) Bachelor's degree in any discipline; preference to candidates with a degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, Agricultural Marketing and Cooperation, IT, Management, Law, Economics or Accountancy; local language proficiency required Not required
Officer Scale-II - General Banking Officer Bachelor's degree in any discipline with minimum 50% aggregate marks; preference to specified subject backgrounds 2 years as an officer in a bank or financial institution
Officer Scale-II - Information Technology Officer Bachelor's degree in Electronics/Communication/Computer Science/IT or equivalent, minimum 50% aggregate marks 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Chartered Accountant Certified Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India 1 year as a Chartered Accountant
Officer Scale-II - Law Officer Degree in Law from a recognised university, minimum 50% aggregate marks 2 years as an advocate, or as a Law Officer in a bank/financial institution
Officer Scale-II - Treasury Manager Chartered Accountant, or MBA in Finance from a recognised university/institution 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Marketing Officer MBA in Marketing from a recognised university 1 year in the relevant field
Officer Scale-II - Agricultural Officer Bachelor's degree in Agriculture/Horticulture/Dairy/Animal Husbandry/Forestry/Veterinary Science/Agricultural Engineering/Pisciculture, minimum 50% aggregate marks 2 years in the relevant field
Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) Bachelor's degree in any discipline, minimum 50% aggregate marks; preference to specified subject backgrounds Minimum 5 years as an officer in a bank or financial institution

Candidates awarded CGPA/OGPA must convert it to a percentage as per their university's own conversion criteria, and the result for the qualifying degree must have been declared on or before 21.09.2026.

IBPS RRB Age Limit

Age is reckoned as on 01.09.2026.

Post Age Limit
Office Assistant (Multipurpose) 18 to 28 years
Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager) Above 18, below 30 years
Officer Scale-II (Manager) Above 21, below 32 years
Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager) Above 21, below 40 years

Age relaxation is available as follows: 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (non-creamy layer), 10 years for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD), and additional relaxation for Ex-Servicemen and (for Office Assistant only) widows, divorced women, and women legally separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC is cumulative with only one other applicable category.

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

IBPS RRB Application Fee

Category Fee (Officer Scale I/II/III) Fee (Office Assistant)
SC/ST/PwBD (and ESM/DESM for Office Assistant) ₹175 (inclusive of GST) ₹175 (inclusive of GST)
All other candidates ₹850 (inclusive of GST) ₹850 (inclusive of GST)

Payment is online only, between 01.09.2026 and 21.09.2026. Bank transaction charges for online payment are to be borne by the candidate. A candidate applying for both an Officer post and the Office Assistant post must pay the fee separately for each.

IBPS RRB Salary & Exam Pattern

Salary: Not specified in the notification.

Exam pattern: The online examination structure differs by post and stage.

Post Stage Sections Total Marks Duration
Office Assistant / Officer Scale-I Preliminary Reasoning, Numerical Ability/Quantitative Aptitude 80 45 minutes
Office Assistant / Officer Scale-I Main Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, General Awareness, English/Hindi Language, Numerical Ability/Quantitative Aptitude 200 120 minutes
Officer Scale-III (Single-level exam) Single Reasoning, Computer Knowledge, Financial Awareness, English/Hindi Language, Quantitative Aptitude & Data Interpretation 200 120 minutes

There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer in the objective tests; unattempted questions are not penalised. Officer Scale-II candidates sit for a single-level examination (structure not itemised separately in the notification excerpt reviewed here beyond the general pattern above).

Also read: IBPS RRB Clerk Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026: Download PDF Here

IBPS RRB Selection Process

  • Office Assistant (Multipurpose): Preliminary Exam → Main Exam → Provisional Allotment (based on Main Exam marks and actual vacancies reported by the RRB).
  • Officer Scale-I: Preliminary Exam → Main Exam → Common Interview → Provisional Allotment.
  • Officer Scale-II & III: Single-level online exam → Common Interview → Provisional Allotment.
  • Interview is out of 100 marks; minimum qualifying marks are 40% (35% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates).
  • The relative weightage for Officer posts is 80% online exam and 20% interview.
  • Interviews for Officer posts are coordinated by the Nodal Regional Rural Bank with the assistance of NABARD and IBPS.

How to Apply for IBPS RRB Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official IBPS website, www.ibps.in, and open the "CRP for RRBs" link on the home page.
  2. Click "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE FOR CRP-RRBs-OFFICERS (Scale-I, II and III)" or "CLICK HERE TO APPLY ONLINE FOR CRP-RRBs-OFFICE ASSISTANTS (Multipurpose)", as applicable.
  3. Click "CLICK HERE FOR NEW REGISTRATION" and enter basic details to generate a provisional registration number and password (also sent by SMS/email).
  4. Log back in using the provisional registration number and password to complete the rest of the form.
  5. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, a handwritten declaration, and your Class 10 (SSC/SSLC) certificate, plus any category/disability certificates applicable to you, as per the scanning specifications in Annexure-III.
  6. Pay the application fee/intimation charges online.
  7. Candidates applying for both Office Assistant and an Officer post, or reconsidering their choice of Officer scale, must register and pay separately for each post.
  8. Take a printout of the final submitted application form for future reference.

Documents Required

  • Printout of the valid interview call letter (for Officer posts)
  • System-generated printout of the online application form
  • Proof of date of birth (birth certificate or Class 10/SSLC certificate showing DOB)
  • Photo identity proof

  • Experience certificate(s), where the post requires post-qualification experience
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL, in the prescribed Government of India format), where applicable
  • Income and Asset Certificate for EWS candidates, where applicable
  • Disability certificate/UDID card, where applicable
  • Ex-servicemen documents (discharge certificate/pension payment order, or the relevant proforma), where applicable

The National Informatics Centre (NIC), under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India, has released a detailed advertisement (Ref No. NIC/STA/2026/2) inviting online applications for the post of Scientific/Technical Assistant-A. This is a Group-B S&T (Non-Gazetted) post to be filled purely on the basis of a valid GATE score (2024, 2025, or 2026), with no written examination or interview involved. Online applications can be submitted from 1 September 2026 to 30 September 2026 through the official portal, recruitment.nic.in.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF Out

NIC has published the detailed advertisement for the Scientific/Technical Assistant-A post on its official recruitment portal. Candidates are advised to read the complete notification carefully before applying online.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for the post is assessed as on the closing date, 30 September 2026, and is based on both a valid GATE score and the prescribed educational qualification.

Valid GATE Score Requirement

Discipline GATE Paper Code
Computer Sciences and Information Technology CS
Electronics and Communication Engineering EC
Data Science and Artificial Intelligence DA

Candidates must possess a valid GATE score from 2024, 2025, or 2026 in the paper code corresponding to the discipline they are applying for.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Educational Qualification

  • Computer Sciences & Information Technology: A pass in M.Sc./MS/MCA/B.E./B.Tech. in Electronics, Electronics and Communication, Electronics & Telecommunication, Computer Sciences, Computer and Networking Security, Software System, Information Technology, or Informatics (single or in combination), along with a valid GATE score in Paper Code CS.
  • Electronics and Communication Engineering: Candidates must possess a valid GATE score in Paper Code EC. The notification does not separately detail the qualifying degree fields for this discipline beyond the GATE requirement.
  • Data Science and Artificial Intelligence: Candidates must possess a valid GATE score in Paper Code DA. The notification does not separately detail the qualifying degree fields for this discipline beyond the GATE requirement.

The candidate must have obtained the essential qualification on or before the closing date. No claim of a qualification equivalent to the prescribed qualification will be entertained. There is no experience requirement for this post.

An additional 5-year age relaxation applies to candidates serving in Government organizations in the same line or allied cadres, where their existing service is relevant to the advertised post. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applies only to posts reserved for them, whereas relaxation for PwBD candidates applies irrespective of reservation status, provided the post is identified as suitable for them.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

The Scientific/Technical Assistant-A post carries a pay of Level 6 under the 7th Central Pay Commission, i.e., ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400 per month, in addition to applicable allowances as per Government of India norms.

Bank charges towards remittance, if any, must be borne by the candidate. The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable.

NIC Scientific/Technical Assistant-A Selection Process

  • Only candidates fulfilling the eligibility criteria and who have completed registration on the NIC portal will be considered for further selection.
  • A category-wise merit list will be prepared for each discipline based on GATE Score, with equal weightage given to GATE 2024, GATE 2025, and GATE 2026 scores.
  • Candidates must submit their best GATE score from any one of the eligible years for the discipline applied.
  • In case of a tie: (1) the older-year GATE score is ranked higher; (2) if the score and year are the same, the older candidate is ranked higher; (3) if still tied, the candidate with a higher percentage in the essential qualification is ranked higher.
  • Shortlisted candidates will be called for Document Verification before being offered a provisional appointment.
  • Non-appearance for document verification with original documents will result in rejection of candidature.
  • Document verification will be conducted at Delhi or any other location/mode approved by the competent authority; no request for postponement or change of location will be entertained, and no TA/DA will be paid.

All document PDFs must be self-attested scanned copies, sized between 10 KB and 500 KB each.

The Department of Posts (India Post), Ministry of Communications, Government of India, has released the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 notification vide Notification No. 17-12/2026-GDS dated 20 August 2026. Applications are invited from eligible candidates to fill tentative vacant posts of Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak in different offices of the Department of Posts across various Circles and Divisions in India. Interested candidates can apply online at the official GDS Online Engagement Portal.

Quick Answer: India Post (Department of Posts) is recruiting for Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) posts - Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Dak Sevak - under the Schedule-II, July-2026 engagement cycle. India Post has announced 23,757 tentative vacancies under the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) engagement. Candidates aged 18-40 years who have passed Class 10 (Secondary School Examination) with passing marks in Mathematics and English, and studied the prescribed local language up to 10th standard, can apply. Online One-Time Registration starts 31 August 2026, and online application submission runs from 2 September 2026 to 21 September 2026 (up to 1700 hrs), at https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement, for postings in rural offices of the Department of Posts across India.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Eligibility for all GDS posts (BPM/ABPM/Dak Sevak) is assessed as on the date of the notification (for qualification) and the last date of application submission (for age), as detailed below.

Criterion Requirement
Educational Qualification Secondary School Examination (SSE)/10th standard pass certificate, with passing marks in Mathematics and English, from a Board recognized by the Government of India/State Governments/Union Territories. Candidates with equivalent qualification from any other board are not eligible.
Local Language Must have studied the local language (as prescribed post-wise for each Circle in Annexure-III of the notification) at least up to 10th standard from a recognized board. Special provisions apply for Arunachal Pradesh, Goa, Sikkim, and Nagaland.
Other Qualifications Knowledge of computers; knowledge of cycling; and adequate means of livelihood besides the GDS allowances (to be submitted as undertakings at the time of engagement)

Note: Past experience or service of any kind is not considered for selection, as per the notification.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Salary (TRCA)

GDS are not regular Central Government employees; they are paid emoluments in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA), which carries an annual increase of 3% (subject to fulfilment of conditions under the GDS Rules), along with Dearness Allowance on TRCA as declared by the Government of India from time to time. GDS are also entitled to GDS Gratuity and the Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (akin to the National Pension System for regular employees).

Category Initial TRCA Slab
Branch Postmaster (BPM) ₹12,000/- to ₹29,380/-
Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM)/Dak Sevak ₹10,000/- to ₹24,470/-

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

A fee of ₹100/- (Rupees One Hundred only) is payable by applicants for all posts notified in their choice of Division. Payment can be made online through recognized Credit/Debit cards, Net Banking, or UPI (usage charges as applicable will be levied). The fee, once paid, is non-refundable, and payment must be completed strictly within the application closing date and time (up to 1700 hrs).

  • Fee-exempted categories: All female applicants, SC/ST applicants, PwBD applicants, and Transwomen applicants
  • Applicants who are exempted may submit their application without making any payment

The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 40 years, to be determined as on the last date of submission of applications, subject to the following relaxations in the upper age limit.

Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

There is no written examination for GDS engagement. Selection is entirely merit-based, computed from the candidate's Class 10 (SSE) academic record.

  • Applicants are shortlisted on the basis of a system-generated merit list
  • The merit list is prepared from marks obtained (or grades/points converted to marks) in the Secondary School Examination (10th standard), aggregated to a percentage up to 4 decimal places
  • Where only grades are given, marks are computed using a multiplication factor of 9.5 against the grade point (e.g., A1 = Grade Point 10 × 9.5); where CGPA is given, marks are computed as CGPA × 9.5, and the higher of the two (individual subject grades vs. CGPA) is taken if both are provided
  • Candidates must enter marks/grades exactly as shown on their marksheet - mixing marks and grades incorrectly, or entering grades where marks are required, can lead to cancellation/disqualification
  • Tie-breaking in the merit list follows a fixed priority order based on date of birth (older preferred) followed by category and gender combinations (ST trans-woman, ST female, SC trans-woman, SC female, and so on down the prescribed order), with the Department reserving the right to apply additional tie-breaking criteria
  • Shortlisted candidates must undergo physical verification of original documents by the Engaging Authority (Divisional/Unit Head), followed by an offer of provisional engagement, pre-engagement formalities (including 3 days of basic training and arranging accommodation), and final regularization after antecedent and document verification

How to Apply for India Post GDS Recruitment 2026

Applications must be submitted online only, in two stages - One-Time Registration (OTR) followed by the Online Application Form.

  1. Visit the GDS Online Engagement Portal: https://indiapost.gov.in/gdsonlineengagement
  2. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using a valid mobile number and email ID (verified via OTP), entering personal details and Class 10 board/year of passing information, to generate a unique Registration Number
  3. Log in using the Registration Number and password received via SMS, then click "Apply Online" under the "Active Notification" tab
  4. Fill in Personal Details, Board/Educational Details (Circle, Board Name, passing year, marks obtained), and select Division and post preferences based on eligible vacancies
  5. Upload a recent photograph (JPG/JPEG, 30-100 KB, 320×400 px, 4:5 aspect ratio) and signature (JPG/JPEG, 20-100 KB, 300×120 px, 5:2 aspect ratio) as per prescribed specifications
  6. Preview the application and make any corrections before final submission
  7. Pay the applicable fee (if not exempted) through the available online payment modes within 10 minutes of initiating payment
  8. Submit the application on or before the last date, and use the two-day edit/correction window (23-24 September 2026) if any corrections are needed

India Post GDS Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Only one registration is permitted per candidate; multiple or duplicate registrations/applications are strictly prohibited and will result in cancellation of candidature
  • Candidates are not required to upload documents with the application, only their photograph and signature; original documents are verified physically at a later stage
  • Name, Date of Birth, Father's name, and Mother's name must be entered exactly as recorded in the Class 10 (Matriculation) certificate, failing which candidature may be cancelled
  • Mobile number and email ID, once registered, cannot be modified under any circumstances
  • Candidates who have been dismissed/removed/compulsorily retired from Government service/GDS in the past as a penalty are barred from applying and must submit an undertaking to this effect
  • SSE marksheets of selected candidates may be verified through DigiLocker/API Setu, and candidates must give consent for this verification
  • Candidates dismissed/removed/retired from Government service in the past as a penalty are barred from applying; a false declaration will lead to termination and possible prosecution
  • No person holding an elective office will be considered for engagement
  • The Department does not make phone calls to applicants; all correspondence is through the Engaging Authority only, and applicants should be cautious of unscrupulous calls seeking personal information
  • The Department reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason

GAIL Online Application Last Date 18 March 2027, 6:00 PM
Age Reckoning Date 18 March 2027
GATE-2027 Examination Date Not specified in this notification - refer to GATE-2027 official website (https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in)

Note: Only GATE-2027 marks are valid for this recruitment. GATE marks of 2026 or earlier years are not valid.

GAIL Executive Trainee Posts & Disciplines

Post Corresponding GATE-2027 Paper GATE Paper Code
Executive Trainee (Chemical) Chemical Engineering CH
Executive Trainee (Instrumentation) Instrumentation Engineering IN
Executive Trainee (Electrical) Electrical Engineering EE
Executive Trainee (Mechanical) Mechanical Engineering ME

A candidate can apply for one post/discipline only; candidates applying for more than one post/discipline will not be considered.

GAIL Executive Trainee GATE-2027 Eligibility

Educational Qualification

Post Minimum Essential Qualification Equivalent Disciplines/Branches Considered
Executive Trainee (Chemical) Bachelor Degree in Engineering with minimum 65% marks Chemical / Petrochemical / Chemical Technology / Petrochemical Technology / Chemical Technology & Polymer Science / Chemical Technology & Plastic Technology
Executive Trainee (Instrumentation) Bachelor Degree in Engineering with minimum 65% marks Instrumentation / Instrumentation & Control / Electronics & Instrumentation / Electrical & Instrumentation / Electronics / Electrical & Electronics
Executive Trainee (Electrical) Bachelor Degree in Engineering with minimum 65% marks Electrical / Electrical, Electronics & Power / Electrical & Electronics / Electrical & Power
Executive Trainee (Mechanical) Bachelor Degree in Engineering with minimum 65% marks Mechanical / Production / Production & Industrial / Manufacturing / Mechanical & Automobile

Note: Engineering Degree can be B.E./B.Tech./B.Sc. Engg. Candidates with a 5-year integrated B.E./B.Tech. + M.E./M.Tech. dual degree in the relevant discipline are also eligible. Candidates with a 5-year integrated B.E./B.Tech. + MBA or B.E./B.Tech. + M.Sc. are also considered, provided the final percentage meets the notified criteria. Candidates with an engineering degree in a branch/discipline other than those listed above are not eligible. Only full-time regular courses from UGC-recognized/AICTE-approved institutions are considered.

Minimum Qualifying Percentage & Passing-Year Conditions

  • General, EWS and OBC (NCL) candidates: minimum 65% marks in the Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • SC/ST/PwBD candidates: minimum 60% marks (a 5% relaxation), applicable only against posts reserved for SC/ST/PwBD. SC/ST/PwBD candidates applying against unreserved posts are assessed under general merit standards with no relaxation in minimum qualifying percentage.
  • No rounding off of marks is allowed (e.g., 64.99% is not treated as 65% for UR category).
  • Eligible candidates: those who completed their Bachelor's degree in Engineering in 2026, OR those currently in the final year (2026–27) of their Engineering degree course.
  • Candidates who completed their Engineering degree in 2025 or earlier are not eligible to apply.
  • Final-year candidates must have secured the minimum prescribed percentage (65%/60% as applicable) in aggregate up to the last semester/year examination at the time of applying, and must submit the final degree certificate (or at least a provisional certificate) and all semester/year mark sheets confirming the minimum prescribed percentage by 31 August 2027.

GAIL Executive Trainee GATE-2027 Age Limit

Particulars Details
Upper Age Limit 26 years as on 18 March 2027 (for all four disciplines)

Age Relaxation

Category Age Relaxation
SC/ST 5 years
OBC (NCL) 3 years
PwBD 10 years
  • Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL) is applicable only against posts reserved for the respective category; if applying against an unreserved post, such candidates are assessed under general merit with no age relaxation.
  • PwBD age relaxation applies irrespective of whether the post is reserved, provided the post is identified suitable for PwBDs.
  • Ex-servicemen with at least six months' continuous service in the Armed Forces may deduct their actual service period from their age; if the resultant age does not exceed the prescribed maximum by more than 3 years, they are deemed to satisfy the age condition.
  • Maximum upper age of the applicant, after all possible relaxations, shall not exceed 56 years.

PwBD-Suitable Categories by Post

Post PwBD Categories Identified Suitable
Executive Trainee (Chemical) Category A: B, LV | Category B: HH | Category C: OA, OL, Dw, AAV | Category D: ASD (M), SLD, MI | Category E: MD involving (A) to (D)
Executive Trainee (Instrumentation) Category B: D, HH | Category C: OL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV | Category D: ASD (M), SLD, MI | Category E: MD involving (B) to (D)
Executive Trainee (Electrical) Category B: D, HH | Category C: OL, Dw, AAV | Category D: ASD (M), SLD, MI | Category E: MD involving (B) to (D)
Executive Trainee (Mechanical) Category B: D, HH | Category C: OA, OL, Dw, AAV | Category D: SLD, MI | Category E: MD involving (B) to (D)

Abbreviations: PwBD – Persons with Benchmark Disabilities; B – Blind; LV – Low Vision; D – Deaf; HH – Hard of Hearing; OA – One Arm; OL – One Leg; CP – Cerebral Palsy; LC – Leprosy Cured; Dw – Dwarfism; AAV – Acid Attack Victims; ASD (M) – Autism Spectrum Disorder (Mild); SLD – Specific Learning Disability; MI – Mental Illness; MD – Multiple Disability.

Pay & Compensation

Not specified in this notification. GAIL states it offers "one of the best compensation packages in terms of Cost to Company"; specific pay scale/CTC details are expected in the detailed February 2027 advertisement.

GAIL Executive Trainee GATE-2027 Selection Process

  • GAIL will use GATE-2027 marks (not GATE 2026 or earlier) to shortlist candidates for Executive Trainee recruitment.
  • Eligible candidates must first register for and appear in GATE-2027 in the relevant paper corresponding to their discipline (see Posts & Disciplines table above).
  • After downloading the GATE-2027 admit card, candidates must separately apply online on the GAIL website, indicating their GATE-2027 Registration Number. Applications without a valid GATE-2027 registration number will be rejected.
  • Based on GATE-2027 marks and requirement, candidates will be shortlisted for the further selection process for the Executive Trainee position.
  • Further details of the selection process (e.g., group discussion/interview stages, if any) are not specified in this notification and are expected in the February 2027 detailed advertisement.

How to Apply for GAIL Executive Trainee (GATE-2027)

  1. Register for and appear in GATE-2027 as per the instructions and timelines notified by the GATE-2027 Organizing Institute, in the GATE paper corresponding to your discipline.
  2. Download your GATE-2027 admit card with registration number once activated, from the official GATE website.
  3. Visit the "Careers" section of the GAIL website: https://gailonline.com.
  4. Apply online, indicating your GATE-2027 Registration Number, within the application window: 17 February 2027, 11:00 AM to 18 March 2027, 6:00 PM.
  5. Apply for only one post/discipline; applications for more than one post/discipline will not be considered.

Important: No other means or mode of application will be accepted. Applications without a valid GATE-2027 registration number will be rejected.

Documents/Certificates Required (at Selection Process Stage)

  • GATE-2027 admit card and registration number
  • Final Engineering degree certificate (at least provisional) and mark sheets of all semesters/years, confirming minimum prescribed percentage, to be submitted by 31 August 2027
  • SC/ST caste certificate in the prescribed Government of India format
  • OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in the prescribed format per DoPT Memo No. 36036/2/2013-Estt.(Res.) dated 30-05-2014, issued in the year of advertisement, plus a self-undertaking of OBC (NCL) status at the time of the selection process
  • EWS candidates: latest Income & Asset Certificate (format per DoPT OM No. 36039/1/2019-Estt.(Res) dated 31.01.2019), valid for financial year 2026-27, based on income/asset verification for FY 2025-26, submitted at the time of the selection process
  • PwBD disability certificate as per the format prescribed by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment vide notification No. G.S.R. 591(E) dated 15.06.2017, for candidates with specified disability of 40% or more
  • CGPA/OGPA/CPI-to-percentage equivalence certificate from the University/Institute, where applicable
  • Pre-Employment Medical Examination report in the prescribed format, from a Central/State Government Hospital (minimum District Hospital status) or a GAIL-nominated empanelled hospital

Prescribed formats for SC/ST, OBC (NCL), EWS and PwBD certificates can be downloaded from the "Careers" section of the GAIL website: https://careers.gail.co.in.

Important Conditions

  • Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.
  • A candidate can apply for one post/discipline only; multiple applications will not be considered.
  • Only GATE-2027 marks are valid for this recruitment exercise; GATE marks of 2026 or earlier are not valid.
  • Candidates who completed their Engineering degree in 2025 or earlier are not eligible to apply.
  • SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates applying against unreserved posts are assessed under general merit, with no relaxation in minimum qualifying percentage or age limit.
  • EWS candidates who fail to produce the Income & Asset Certificate at the time of the selection process will not be allowed to appear for the selection process, and requests for change of category will not be entertained.
  • Appointment is subject to the candidate being medically fit as per GAIL's prescribed standards; GAIL reserves the right to re-examine or review the medical report, and the decision of the designated CMO, GAIL, is final and binding.
  • Any revision, clarification, addendum, corrigendum, or time extension to this advertisement will be hosted only on the "Careers" section of https://gailonline.com; no separate notification will be issued through any other media.
  • Any dispute regarding this recruitment is subject to the jurisdiction of the Delhi High Court only.
  • GAIL has cautioned the general public against dubious agencies/organizations/individuals circulating fake GAIL job advertisements via e-mail, social media, etc.; candidates should rely only on https://gailonline.com for authentic information.

Sahitya Akademi (National Academy of Letters), an autonomous organization under the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, has released a recruitment notice (Advertisement No. 50/2/2026, dated 22 August 2026) inviting applications for 30 posts across 13 designations - including Deputy Secretary, Assistant Editor, Junior Translation Officer, Stenographer, Junior Clerk, and Multi-Tasking Staff - on a direct recruitment basis. Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates

  • Date of Advertisement: 22 August 2026
  • Last Date to Apply: 21 October 2026 (Extended) (within 30 days of publication of the advertisement in Employment News)

Sahitya Akademi Vacancy 2026 - Post Details

A total of 30 posts are to be filled across 13 designations, with category-wise breakup as shown below.

Sahitya Akademi Eligibility Criteria & Educational Qualification

Post Name Pay Level Essential Qualification & Experience (summary)
Deputy Secretary (General-Admin.) Level-11 Master's Degree in Language (min. 55% marks) with 7 years' experience as Assistant Director/Assistant Secretary/Administrative Officer/Assistant Registrar or equivalent in Level 10 and above; OR Master's in Business/Public Administration (min. 55%) with the same 7 years' experience. Must also have demonstrable experience organizing literary activities/programmes/seminars/conferences/festivals at institutional, regional, or national level, and an unblemished integrity record (no pending criminal/vigilance/disciplinary proceedings, court case involving moral turpitude/financial irregularity, or chargesheet/prosecution sanction as on the closing date).
Assistant Editor Level-10 Post-graduate degree in a language/literature recognized by the Akademi; good knowledge of English/Hindi and one or more regional Indian languages; 5 years' experience in copy-editing literary/scholarly manuscripts through production stages; basic computer knowledge.
Senior Library & Information Assistant Level-6 Bachelor in Library Science; 5 years' experience in a library of standing; good computer knowledge for library applications.
Junior Translation Officer Level-6 Graduate/Master's with Hindi/English as main subject (or equivalent combinations, per notification) plus a translation diploma/certificate where applicable; 3 years' experience in literary translation (Hindi-English/English-Hindi) in Central/State Government including autonomous organizations.
Technical Assistant Level-6 Graduate/equivalent; Diploma in Book Publishing; 5 years' experience in a printing press/publishing house/government undertaking concerned with book publication; knowledge of printing and book-publication processes; ability to edit literary material; basic computer knowledge.
Programme Assistant Level-6 Graduate/equivalent from a recognized university; 5 years' experience in a literary, academic, or government organization, or a publishing house; ability to organize meetings/conferences and handle literary material; good computer knowledge.
Publication Assistant Level-6 Graduate/equivalent; Diploma in Printing OR 5 years' experience in a printing press/publishing house/government undertaking on book publication; knowledge of printing/publication processes; basic computer knowledge.
Proof Reader Cum General Assistant Level-4 Graduate/equivalent with Hindi/English as a subject; ability to read proofs in English/Hindi; proficiency in English/Hindi; basic computer knowledge.
Stenographer Gr. II Level-4 10+2 or equivalent; 80 w.p.m. shorthand speed with good typing speed in English/Hindi; good computer knowledge.
Messenger Cum Rider Level-2 10+2; valid motor driving licence for two-wheelers/car with 3 years' experience; knowledge of motor mechanics.
Van Driver Level-2 10th or 10+2; valid driving licence for light and heavy vehicles; knowledge of minor automobile repairs; 3 years' motor-driving experience; polite behaviour.
Junior Clerk Level-2 10+2; net typing speed of 35 w.p.m. in English or 30 w.p.m. in Hindi; knowledge of computer applications.
Multi-Tasking Staff Level-1 10th/10+2 from a recognized board/institution, or ITI equivalent; multi-skilling ability (one employee performing tasks previously handled by different Level-1 employees); basic computer knowledge.

Each post also carries additional "Desirable" (preferred, not mandatory) qualifications specified in the official notification - such as research/doctoral degrees, knowledge of additional Indian languages, or general knowledge of Indian literature - which candidates should review in full before applying. All educational qualifications, age, and experience must be fulfilled as on the closing date of application.

Sahitya Akademi Salary

Pay is as per the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, ranging from Level-1 (₹18,000–56,900) for Multi-Tasking Staff to Level-11 (₹67,700–2,08,700) for Deputy Secretary. See the Eligibility table above for the pay level of each post.

In continuation of the notification dated 22 August 2026 inviting applications for various posts in Sahitya Akademi, it is hereby inform that the application fee prescribed therein stand withdrawn.

EWS/PwD Nil

SC/ST/Women ₹500
EWS/PwD Nil

Sahitya Akademi Age Limit

  • Maximum age: 50 years for all 13 posts
  • Age relaxation: as per Government of India rules
  • Age (along with qualification and experience) is assessed as on the closing date of application

Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

Sahitya Akademi Selection Process

  • Deputy Secretary (General-Admin.) and Assistant Editor: Selection is based purely on performance in the interview (no written test specified).
  • Level-6 posts (Senior Library & Information Assistant, Junior Translation Officer, Technical Assistant, Programme Assistant, Publication Assistant): Written test of 100 marks - Part-I objective (50 marks: 30 questions GS/GK + 5 each from Hindi, English, Computer, Quantitative Aptitude; 1 mark per correct answer, no negative marking) and Part-II descriptive (50 marks, post-specific - e.g. Library Science, Translation, Publication/Printing). Duration: 2 hours.
  • Level-4 posts (Proof Reader Cum General Assistant, Stenographer Gr. II): Same 100-mark, 2-part written test structure as Level-6 posts, with post-specific Part-II content (Editing/Proof Reading, or Essay/Letter/Comprehension for Stenographer). Stenographer Gr. II candidates are additionally shortlisted for a qualifying skill test (80 w.p.m. shorthand + typing speed).
  • Level-1 and Level-2 posts (Messenger Cum Rider, Van Driver, Junior Clerk, Multi-Tasking Staff): Written test of 100 marks - Part-I objective (60 marks: 40 GS/GK + 5 each from Hindi Grammar, English Grammar, Computer, Quantitative Aptitude; no negative marking) and Part-II descriptive (40 marks: Essay, Letter, English Comprehension, Notice/Advertisement, 10 marks each). Duration: 2 hours. Messenger Cum Rider and Van Driver candidates additionally undergo a qualifying driving skill test; Junior Clerk candidates undergo a qualifying typing test (35 w.p.m. English / 30 w.p.m. Hindi).
  • Where a departmental candidate is selected for Senior Library & Information Assistant, Junior Translation Officer, Technical Assistant, or Publication Assistant, it is treated as a promotion by selection.
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the written examination/skill test/interview; no interim correspondence will be entertained.

How to Apply for Sahitya Akademi Recruitment 2026

  1. Download the prescribed application format from the Akademi's website: https://sahitya-akademi.gov.in.
  2. Fill the application giving full details, and attach a recent self-attested passport-size photograph along with self-attested copies of all required documents.
  3. Submit a separate application form for each post applied for (applying more than once for the same post may lead to cancellation of candidature).
  4. Superscribe the envelope "Application for the post of ________" (naming the specific post).
  5. Send the application by Speed Post or Registered Post only, addressed to: The Secretary, Sahitya Akademi, Rabindra Bhavan, 35 Ferozeshah Road, New Delhi-110001.
  6. Ensure the application reaches within 30 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News (last date: 21 October 2026). Applications sent by email, or incomplete, unsigned, undocumented, or late applications, will be rejected.

Sahitya Akademi Documents Required

  • Recent self-attested passport-size photograph
  • Self-attested copies of all educational qualification certificates
  • Self-attested experience certificates
  • Self-attested category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen, as applicable) in the prescribed Government of India format - OBC certificates must specifically state the candidate does not belong to the creamy layer
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC), for candidates currently serving in Central/State Government, Autonomous Bodies, or PSUs (or they may apply through proper channel)
  • For candidates serving at Level-10 (₹56,100–1,77,500) and above: last five years' ACRs/APARs, an integrity certificate, and vigilance clearance from the current employer

Sahitya Akademi Important Instructions

  • Applications must be submitted only in the prescribed format available on the Akademi's website; applications without this format, or without self-attested copies of educational documents, experience, and caste certificates, will be liable to rejection.
  • Candidates are responsible for assessing their own eligibility for the post; furnishing false, tampered, or fabricated information, or suppressing material information, will lead to cancellation of candidature/appointment at any stage - even after appointment - without further notice.
  • The number of posts advertised may vary, and the Akademi reserves the right to fill or not fill any advertised post(s).
  • Candidates should apply early to avoid last-minute rush; the Akademi is not responsible for postal or courier delays.
  • Any addendum or corrigendum will be posted only on the Akademi's website (https://sahitya-akademi.gov.in).
  • Candidates called for written test/skill test/interview must attend at their own expense; no TA/DA will be paid.
  • The Akademi reserves the right to fix additional shortlisting criteria if a large number of applications are received for any post.
  • The selected incumbent is liable to be transferred to any office of the Akademi located in India.
  • If any inadvertent mistake in the selection process is detected at any stage, even after issue of the appointment letter, the Akademi reserves the right to modify/cancel/withdraw any communication made to the candidate.
  • The qualifications prescribed are as per Sahitya Akademi rules, pending approval of the Ministry.

HLL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

The notification indicates selection is carried out through an interview with document verification; it does not describe a separate written examination stage. Broadly, the process includes:

  • Interview of eligible candidates, at which all information submitted in the application is verified against original documents
  • Submission of a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the interview, for candidates currently employed in Government, Semi-Government, PSU or Autonomous Bodies
  • Final selection decision, which rests with HLL Management and is stated to be final

If any information provided by a candidate is found to be false, incorrect, or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, the candidature is liable to be rejected or cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process. HLL also reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the selection process, or to not fill any or all of the posts notified, and the number of vacancies may be increased or decreased based on organizational requirements.

Important: Candidates awaiting final examination results of the prescribed educational qualification are NOT eligible and should not apply. Persons appointed as Clerk-cum-Typist must qualify a typing test (30 w.p.m. English / 25 w.p.m. Hindi) within four years of appointment.

Western Railway Sports Quota Age Limit

Particular Detail
Age Limit Minimum 18 years, maximum 25 years as on 01-01-2027
Eligible Date of Birth Range Born between 01-01-2002 and 01-01-2009 (both days inclusive)

Sports Achievement Eligibility Norms

Only sportspersons who acquired eligibility norms in championships held between 01-04-2024 and the date of notification, and who are currently active, are eligible to apply. The concluding day of the championship/event determines validity.

Level Minimum Sports Norms Required
Level 5/4 Represented the country in Olympic Games (Senior) OR at least 3rd position in World Cup (Junior/Youth/Senior) OR World Championships (Junior/Senior) OR Asian Games (Senior) OR Commonwealth Games (Senior) OR Youth Olympics OR Champions Trophy (Hockey) OR Thomas/Uber Cup (Badminton)
Level 3/2 Represented the country in World Cup/World Championships/Asian Games/Commonwealth Games/Youth Olympics/Champions Trophy/Thomas-Uber Cup, OR at least 3rd position in Commonwealth Championship, Asian Championship/Asia Cup, South Asian Federation Games, USIC (World Railways) Championship, or World University Games, OR at least 3rd position in Senior/Youth/Junior National Championships, OR at least 3rd position in National Games (Indian Olympic Association), OR at least 3rd position in All India Inter University Championship, OR 1st position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior)
Level 1 Represented in Commonwealth Championship/Asian Championship/South Asian Federation Games/USIC Championship/World University Games, OR at least 3rd position in Federation Cup Championships (Senior), OR represented a State/equivalent unit (except Marathon and Cross Country) with at least 8th position in Senior National Championships

Discipline-Specific Norm Variations

  • Athletics: Medal-winning performance in the National Inter State Senior Athletics Championship may be considered for Level 3/2 and below; Gold medal in Open National Championship (Senior), Inter State Athletics Championship (Senior), or Asian Championship (Senior) may be considered for Level 5/4 and below.
  • Ball Badminton: Achievements in BBFI-affiliated events after 17-12-2025 till the date of notification will be considered.
  • Body Building: IBBF-affiliated event achievements after 31-12-2021 will not be considered; Association of Indian Universities and recognized International Federation certificates remain permissible.
  • Boxing: "Youth" category achievements on or after 25-09-2016 in International Championships are considered in place of "Junior" category.
  • Cricket (Men & Women), Level 3/2: Quarter-finalist in Senior/U-23/U-19 All India Inter State Group Championships (except Plate group), OR participation in Senior/U-23/U-19 All India Inter-Zonal Championship, OR participation in Senior/U-23/U-19 Challenger Trophy.
  • Handball (Men & Women): Achievements in events organized by Handball Association of India (or affiliates) on or after 05-09-2023 will not be considered; Association of Indian Universities and International Federation certificates remain permissible.
  • Hockey (Men), Level 3/2: Participation in International Tournaments (4+ nations, Senior or Junior) or semi-finalist in Senior National Championships may also be considered. Hockey (Women), Level 3/2: At least 2nd position in International Tournaments of 4+ nations may also be considered.
  • Volleyball (Women): Achievements in events conducted by Volleyball Federation of India after 02-01-2017 will not be considered; Association of Indian Universities and International Federation certificates remain permissible.
  • Powerlifting (Men & Women): Achievements in IPF-affiliated events after 03-10-2017 will not be considered; Association of Indian Universities and International Federation certificates remain permissible.
  • Weightlifting (Men & Women): New bodyweight categories effective 01-06-2025 will be applied.
  • Wrestling: Certificates for events conducted by WFI or affiliates after 10-03-2025 till the date of notification shall be considered.
Note: Championships must be conducted under the aegis of a recognized International/National Sports Federation and recognized by the Railway Sports Promotion Board (RSPB); certificates from federations not recognized by MoYAS at the time of the championship will not be accepted. A sportsperson can be considered only in the event/position/game in which they hold recognized norms. Selection is further subject to fitting into the Western Railway Sports Association (WRSA) team.

Application Fee

Category Fee
All candidates, except those in the row below ₹500, with ₹400 refunded to those found eligible and who actually appear in the trial (after bank charges)
SC / ST / Ex-Servicemen / Persons with Disability / Women / Minorities / Economically Backward Class (EBC) ₹250, fully refunded to those found eligible and who actually appear in the trial (after bank charges)
  • Fee must be paid online through the payment gateway integrated with the application; no edits are allowed after payment.
  • Payment methods: Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI, etc. Transaction charges, if any, are borne by the candidate.
  • Applications without fee payment will be summarily rejected.
  • Minorities means Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Zoroastrians (Parsis) and Jains; a self-declaration (Annexure-A) must be uploaded, followed by an affidavit at document verification.
  • EBC means family income below ₹50,000 per annum; an income certificate (Annexure-B) issued by a prescribed authority is required.

Western Railway Sports Quota Selection Procedure

All eligible candidates are called for a Selection Trial. Only candidates securing 25 or more out of 40 marks for game skill, physical fitness, and coach's observations are declared FIT and assessed further by the Recruitment Committee. Candidates declared NOT FIT are not assessed further.

Distribution of Marks

Description Maximum Marks
Recognized sports achievements (as per norms) 50
Game skill, physical fitness & coach's observation during trial 40
Educational Qualification 10
Total 100

Minimum Qualifying Marks

Level Grade Pay Minimum Qualifying Marks
Level 5/4 2800/2400 70 marks
Level 3/2 2000/1900 65 marks
Level 1 1800 60 marks
The offer of appointment is purely on merit. If two or more sportspersons score the same marks, preference is given to the younger candidate. No TA/DA/accommodation is provided for the trial; candidates must bring their own kit and four passport-size photographs, and may need to stay 2-3 days at their own arrangement.

How to Apply for Western Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official website rrc-wr.com.
  2. Log on to the RRC/WR online application portal and fill in personal details/bio-data carefully.
  3. Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Card number (or 28-digit Aadhaar Enrolment ID if the card is not yet received).
  4. Fill in educational qualification and sports achievement details, mentioning the specific position/event/discipline.
  5. Upload the required scanned photograph (3.5cm x 3.5cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20-70 KB) without cap or sunglasses.
  6. Upload the scanned signature (3.5cm x 2.5cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20-30 KB), not in block/capital or disjoined letters.
  7. Pay the applicable application fee online through the integrated payment gateway.
  8. Note the Registration Number generated on submission for future reference.
  9. Take a printout of the application; it must be produced at the time of the Selection Trial.
Important: A separate application with separate fee is required for each discipline and for each pay level applied to. Multiple applications for a single discipline with differing particulars, or a single application for two or more events/games, will be summarily rejected.

Documents Required

  • Scanned copy of minimum academic qualification mark sheet/certificate (per applicable level)
  • Certificate proving recognized sports achievement held between 01-04-2024 and the date of notification
  • Certificate for proof of date of birth (SSC certificate or equivalent mark sheet)
  • Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates, where applicable
  • OBC declaration (Annexure-E), where applicable
  • Minority Community Declaration (Annexure-A), where applicable
  • Income certificate for EBC fee exemption (Annexure-B), where applicable
  • Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrolment slip (original, at the time of trial)

Important Conditions

  • Name, father's name, and date of birth must exactly match across educational and sports certificates; any name change must be supported by a Gazette Notification or equivalent legal document, predating the online application.
  • Candidates must keep their mobile number and e-mail ID active throughout the recruitment process; all official communication via SMS/e-mail/website is deemed read.
  • Original documents (date of birth, educational qualification, sports achievement) must be produced on the day of trial; certificates in languages other than English/Hindi require an attested translation.
  • Selected candidates may be posted anywhere on Western Railway and are liable for transfer to another Railway/establishment as per exigencies of service.
  • Selected male candidates finally appointed are liable for active service in the Railway Engineers Unit of the Territorial Army.
  • Selected candidates must submit a Service Bond of 5 years at the time of appointment.
  • Appointment is subject to passing the requisite Medical Fitness Test, and final verification of educational/community certificates and antecedents.
  • Candidates already employed in a PSU/Government Organization must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of trial.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate; the decision of the Selection Committee/Railway Administration is final and binding.
  • RRC/WR has not appointed any agent or coaching centre on its behalf; candidates should beware of touts and fraudulent job offers.

Southern Railway (SR), through the Office of the Chief Workshop Manager, Carriage & Wagon Works, Perambur, has released Notification No. 01/2026 inviting online applications for engagement as Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, in various trades across Divisions/Workshops/Units under its jurisdiction. This is a training engagement, not an employment offer - there is no guarantee of employment on completion of training.

Southern Railway Act Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - Category & Unit-wise Details

Vacancies are divided into two categories - Fresher (163 posts) and Ex-ITI (4,308 posts) - spread across Carriage & Wagon Works Perambur, Central Workshop Ponmalai, Signal & Telecommunication Workshop Podanur, Railway Hospital Perambur, and multiple divisions (Chennai, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Palakkad, Salem, Trivandrum).

Both discrepancies are in the source document and should be verified before publishing.

The notification also clarifies that vacancies are tentative and subject to change, and reservation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD is as per prescribed norms.

Southern Railway Act Apprentice Eligibility Criteria

Only candidates residing within the following areas (Geographical Jurisdiction of Southern Railway) are eligible to apply:

  • Whole State of Tamil Nadu
  • Whole Union Territory of Puducherry
  • Whole State of Kerala
  • Whole Union Territories of Andaman & Nicobar and Lakshadweep Islands
  • Only two districts of Andhra Pradesh: SPSR Nellore and Chittoor
  • Only one district of Karnataka: Dakshina Kannada

Candidates must also meet the minimum standards of physical fitness under Schedule-II of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, verified through a medical certificate from a Government-Authorized Doctor at the time of document verification.

Southern Railway Act Apprentice Qualification

Fresher Category:

  • Fitter, Painter, Welder - Passed 10th Class (minimum 50% aggregate) under the 10+2 system or equivalent.
  • Medical Laboratory Technician (Radiology/Pathology/Cardiology) - Passed 12th Class (minimum 50% aggregate) with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology.

Ex-ITI Category:

  • Most trades (Fitter, Machinist, MMV, Turner, Diesel Mechanic, Carpenter, Painter, Welder(G&E), Wireman, Advance Welder, Plumber, Draughtsman-Civil, Instrument Mechanic, Mech. R&AC, Gas Cutter, MMTM, Structural Welder) - Passed 10th Class (min. 50%) + ITI course in the relevant trade with an NCVT/SCVT certificate.
  • Electrician - Same as above, with Science as a subject in 10th.
  • Electronics Mechanic - Same as above, with Science (Physics & Chemistry) and Mathematics.
  • Secretarial Assistant & Stenographer (English) - Passed 12th Class + ITI course with NCVT/SCVT certificate.
  • ICTSM - Passed 10th Class + ITI course with NCVT/SCVT certificate.
  • COPA/PASAA - Passed 10th Class (min. 50%) + National Trade Certificate in Computer Operator and Programming Assistant.

Note: The minimum 50% requirement in 10th standard does not apply to SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAAs), Engineering Graduates/Diploma holders, or Vocational Certificate holders with one year or more of training/job experience after these qualifications are not eligible.

Southern Railway Act Apprentice Age Limit

As on the date of notification (28-08-2026):

  • Minimum age: 15 years completed
  • Maximum age: 22 years (Fresher/Ex-ITI) / 24 years (MLT)
  • Upper age relaxation: 3 years for OBC-(NCL), 5 years for SC/ST, 10 years for PwBD
  • Combined relaxation for PwBD candidates: UR/EWS + PwBD = 10 years; OBC-(NCL) + PwBD = 13 years; SC/ST + PwBD = 15 years

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

Southern Railway Act Apprentice Stipend

Category Stipend (per month)
Fresher's - 10th Std Rs. 8,200/-
Fresher's - 12th Std Rs. 9,600/-
Ex-ITI Rs. 9,600/-

Stipend increases by 10% in the second year of training and a further 15% in the third year, over the prescribed minimum.

Southern Railway Act Apprentice Application Fee

Processing fee of Rs. 100/- (non-refundable), payable online. No fee is required for SC/ST/PwBD/Women candidates.

Southern Railway Act Apprentice Selection Process

Selection is based on a Merit List, prepared as follows:

  • Fresher Category: Matriculation marks converted to 200 (minimum 50% aggregate required, except SC/ST/PwBD).
  • Ex-ITI Category: Matriculation marks converted to 100 + ITI marks converted to 100 = 200 total, with equal weightage to both.
  • MLT Category: Higher Secondary marks (Physics, Chemistry, Maths & Biology) converted to 200.

In case of a tie, the older candidate is preferred; if birth dates are also the same, the candidate who passed Matriculation earlier is preferred.

How to Apply for Southern Railway Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit www.sr.indianrailways.gov.in
  2. Navigate to News & Updates → Personnel Branch Information
  3. Complete the online application in all respects before the closing date.
  4. Submit the application online between 28-08-2026 and 27-09-2026 (till 17:00 Hrs).

Southern Railway Act Apprentice Important Instructions

  • This notification is purely for apprenticeship training, not employment - there is no guarantee of employment after training.
  • 20% of vacancies in Direct Recruitment to Level 1 posts may give preference to Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAAs) holding a National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC).
  • All official communication - notifications, document verification lists, selection and eligibility results - will be posted only on the official website link mentioned above.
  • Candidates availing SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD benefits must produce the relevant certificate at document verification, else they will be treated as UR.
  • False declarations will lead to disqualification/termination at any stage without notice.
  • Candidates are responsible for arranging their own accommodation during training.
  • Ex-ITI candidates must possess the relevant ITI qualification at the time of applying.
