What Is a Bharat Sarkari Job?

A Bharat Sarkari Job is any government job opportunity offered across India's central and state government departments - spanning all 28 states and 8 union territories. The term "Bharat" simply emphasises pan-India coverage: a Bharat Sarkari Job notification could originate from a central body like the SSC, UPSC, or Indian Railways, or from a state public service commission recruiting for state-level posts. Regardless of origin, these roles share the defining traits Indian aspirants seek - long-term job security, government pay scales, and statutory retirement benefits.

Sarkari Job vs Private Job

A sarkari job differs from private-sector employment in a few important ways: government positions are governed by service rules that protect against arbitrary termination, salaries follow Pay Commission recommendations rather than market negotiation, and employees are entitled to pension schemes (NPS or OPS depending on recruitment year), medical coverage under CGHS, and fixed working hours. Private jobs, by contrast, often offer higher starting pay in competitive fields but carry less structural job security.

Sarkari Bharat Vacancies by Sector

Sarkari bharat vacancies span several major recruiting sectors. Each sector below links to a dedicated hub page with sector-specific notifications, eligibility criteria, and exam patterns.

Banking Jobs (IBPS, SBI, RBI)

Banking recruitment includes IBPS PO, IBPS Clerk, SBI PO, SBI Clerk, RBI Assistant, and NABARD postings. These roles are among the most competitive sarkari bharat jobs, offering strong starting pay and clear promotion tracks. Browse current openings on our Banking Jobs hub.

Railway Jobs (RRB NTPC, ALP, Group D)

Indian Railways is the country's largest single recruiter, with RRB NTPC, Group D, ALP, JE, and Technician posts opening in large batches. Check live Railway vacancies on our Railway Jobs hub.

Defence Jobs (Army, Navy, Air Force)

Defence recruitment covers Indian Army (including Agniveer), Navy, Air Force, BSF, CRPF, CISF, and ITBP postings. See ongoing openings on our Defence Jobs hub.

Teaching Jobs (KVS, NVS, State Boards)

Teaching sarkari jobs include KVS, NVS, DSSSB, and state education board recruitment for TGT, PGT, and PRT posts. Explore current teaching vacancies on our Teaching Jobs hub.

SSC & UPSC Notifications

SSC (CGL, CHSL, MTS, GD) and UPSC (Civil Services, CDS, NDA) notifications remain the most closely tracked central-government exams. Full notification archives are available on our SSC Jobs and UPSC Jobs hubs.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 कैसे भरें? (How to Apply Online)

हर साल लाखों उम्मीदवार सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 भरने की प्रक्रिया में गलतियाँ कर बैठते हैं, जिससे उनका आवेदन रद्द हो सकता है। नीचे दी गई सरल प्रक्रिया से आप अपना फॉर्म सही तरीके से भर सकते हैं।

आवेदन की चरणबद्ध प्रक्रिया

  1. संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना (Notification PDF) ध्यान से पढ़ें और अपनी पात्रता जांचें।
  2. वैध ईमेल आईडी और मोबाइल नंबर से पोर्टल पर पंजीकरण (Registration) करें।
  3. व्यक्तिगत विवरण, शैक्षणिक योग्यता, और आवश्यक दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें (फोटो, हस्ताक्षर, प्रमाणपत्र)।
  4. निर्धारित आवेदन शुल्क का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें और भुगतान की रसीद सुरक्षित रखें।
  5. फॉर्म सबमिट करने से पहले सभी जानकारी की दोबारा जांच करें और फॉर्म का प्रिंटआउट अवश्य लें।

Documents Required for Sarkari Form

Typical documents needed: recent passport-size photograph (as per specified size/format), scanned signature, educational certificates and mark sheets, category certificate (if applicable), and a valid ID proof (Aadhaar/PAN).

Common Mistakes to Avoid While Applying

  • Submitting a photo or signature that doesn't match the specified pixel/size requirements.
  • Missing the last date due to server load - apply at least 2–3 days before deadline.
  • Entering a name or date of birth that doesn't match your certificates exactly.
  • Forgetting to download and save the final submitted form and payment receipt.

Use the qualification filters on this page to sarkari job find openings suited to 10th pass, 12th pass, diploma, graduate, or postgraduate candidates, sorted by sector and state.

सरकारी फॉर्म ऑनलाइन 2026 में आवेदन कैसे करें?

सबसे पहले संबंधित विभाग की आधिकारिक अधिसूचना पढ़ें, पात्रता जांचें, फिर वैध ईमेल और मोबाइल नंबर से रजिस्ट्रेशन करके फॉर्म भरें, दस्तावेज़ अपलोड करें और आवेदन शुल्क जमा करें।

Is OnlyJobs reliable for sarkarijob updates?

Yes - OnlyJobs has tracked sarkarijob notifications since 2011, cross-verifying every listing against official department websites before publishing.

What is the difference between a Sarkari Job and a private-sector job?

Sarkari jobs offer government-backed job security, pension (NPS/OPS), fixed working hours, and statutory benefits, while private jobs typically offer market-driven pay with fewer long-term security guarantees.

Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 – FAQ's

How to apply for Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 online?

Visit your state's official WCD / ICDS portal (link provided in table above). Register with mobile & Aadhaar, fill the application form, upload documents (photo, 10th certificate, Aadhaar, domicile), and submit before the last date. Print the application acknowledgement slip after submission.

What is the eligibility for Anganwadi Worker 2026?

Candidates must have passed 10th or 12th standard from a recognized board. Age limit is 18–35 years (varies by state). Must be a permanent resident of the ward/village for which vacancy exists. Only female candidates are eligible for Worker and Helper posts.

What is the salary of Anganwadi Worker in 2026?

Anganwadi Worker receives a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000–₹20,000 depending on the state (Karnataka and TN are highest at ~₹14,000). Anganwadi Helper gets ₹5,000–₹7,000/month. The Central Government pays ₹4,500/month as base honorarium, and states add their own component on top.

Is there a written exam for Anganwadi jobs?

No, there is no written examination for Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Selection is purely merit-based on academic qualification marks (10th / 12th percentage). For Supervisor / CDPO posts, a written exam or interview may be conducted depending on the state.

What is the age limit for Anganwadi Helper?

Age limit is 18 to 35 years as of 1st January 2026 in most states. SC/ST candidates get 5 years relaxation (maximum age 40). OBC candidates get 3 years relaxation (maximum age 38). PwD candidates get additional relaxation as per state rules.

What documents are required for Anganwadi job application?

Required documents: Aadhaar card, 10th/12th marksheet and certificate, domicile/residence certificate, caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC), passport-size photograph, scanned signature, and EWS/PwD certificate if applicable. Graduation certificate is needed for Supervisor post applications.

What is ICDS recruitment 2026?

ICDS stands for Integrated Child Development Services - the government programme under which Anganwadi centres operate nationwide. ICDS recruitment 2026 refers to hiring of Anganwadi Workers, Helpers, Supervisors, and CDPOs by state WCD departments under the Ministry of Women & Child Development (wcd.nic.in).

Is Anganwadi Worker a permanent government job?

Anganwadi Workers and Helpers are honorary workers, not regular government employees. They receive a fixed monthly honorarium (not salary) and are entitled to benefits like ESI, health insurance, and maternity benefits. Supervisors and CDPOs are regular government employees in most states and receive full pay & grade pay.

Can I apply for Anganwadi job from a different district?

No. Anganwadi Workers and Helpers must be permanent residents of the same ward/village/district where the vacancy exists. A domicile or residence certificate is mandatory. Applications from outside the specified locality are rejected. For Supervisor/CDPO posts, the same district residency rule generally applies.

Forest Department Posts List

The forest department offers a range of posts across different levels, from ground-level field roles to gazetted officer positions. Most current openings on this page are for Group C posts - Forest Guard, Forester, Beat Guard, and Field Guard - making this a common landing point for anyone searching forest department group c recruitment 2026.

  • Forest Guard - entry-level field post responsible for forest protection and anti-poaching patrols
  • Forester - supervises Forest Guards and manages a forest beat or range sub-unit
  • Forest Beat Officer - field-level post combining patrol, record-keeping, and community liaison duties; commonly searched as forest beat officer notification 2026
  • Range Forest Officer (RFO) - manages an entire forest range, includes administrative and enforcement responsibilities
  • Assistant Conservator of Forests (ACF) - gazetted officer post, typically recruited through state forest service exams
  • Indian Forest Service (IFS) Officer - recruited through UPSC, the highest field-level forestry cadre in India

Eligibility for Forest Department Jobs 2026

Educational Qualification

  • Forest Guard / Forest Watcher / Field Guard: 10th or 12th pass from a recognized board
  • Forester: 12th pass, often with Science subjects; some states require a diploma in Forestry
  • Range Forest Officer: Graduate degree, frequently in Science, Agriculture, or Forestry
  • ACF / IFS: Graduate degree in a relevant discipline (Botany, Zoology, Forestry, Agriculture, Veterinary Science, Engineering, or Environmental Science), followed by the respective state or UPSC exam

Age Limit & Relaxation

The general age limit for Forest Guard and Forester posts is usually 18–27 years, though this varies by state. Age relaxation is generally available for SC/ST (5 years), OBC (3 years), PwBD candidates, and other reserved categories as per government norms.

Reservation & Age Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen

Most state forest departments reserve a fixed percentage of Forest Guard, Forester, and Beat Guard posts for ex-servicemen, in addition to SC, ST, OBC, and EWS reservations. Candidates applying for jobs for ex servicemen in forest department typically receive:

  • Additional age relaxation, usually 3–5 years beyond the general age cap (or as per length of military service)
  • Relaxed physical standards in several states
  • A reserved vacancy quota, separate from the general merit list

Exact quota percentages and relaxation norms differ by state, so always cross-check the specific notification before applying.

Physical Standards

Most Forest Guard and Forester posts require candidates to clear height, chest measurement (for male candidates), and a Physical Efficiency Test involving running, walking, or trekking - since the job involves regular field patrol duty in forest terrain.

Selection Process & Exam Pattern for Forest Officer & Forest Guard Posts

The selection process for forest department recruitment generally involves multiple stages, designed to test both academic knowledge and physical fitness given the field nature of the job.

Written Exam, PET/PST & Document Verification

  1. Written Examination - objective-type questions on General Knowledge, General Science, Reasoning, Mathematics, and sometimes Forestry/Environment-related topics
  2. Physical Efficiency Test (PET) / Physical Standard Test (PST) - running, walking/trekking distance, height and chest measurement
  3. Document Verification - verification of educational certificates, age proof, category certificates, and (where applicable) ex-servicemen discharge documents
  4. Medical Examination - fitness check before final appointment
  5. Final Merit List - based on combined written exam and PET/PST scores, as per each state's weightage formula

Syllabus Highlights for Forest Guard & Ranger

  • General Knowledge & Current Affairs
  • General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology basics)
  • Basic Mathematics / Numerical Ability
  • Reasoning & Mental Ability
  • State-specific General Knowledge (local geography, forests, wildlife sanctuaries)
  • For Ranger/RFO level: Forestry science, environmental laws, and wildlife protection acts

Two Types of No Exam Govt Jobs

No-exam recruitment in India falls into two patterns, and knowing which one a notification belongs to tells you exactly what to prepare for:

Type Typical Posts Who it's for How Selection Works
Fresher - no exam, usually no interview Apprentice, GDS, trainee 10th/12th/ITI/Diploma/Graduate pass Merit list prepared from academic marks
Experienced - no exam, interview-based Officer, manager, specialist, medical Professionals with relevant work experience Shortlisting based on qualification/experience, followed by a personal interview

How Recruitment Without Exam Works in Government Jobs

This section explains the different routes through which government departments fill vacancies without conducting a written competitive exam.

1. Direct Recruitment

Certain senior and specialised posts - such as Chairman, Member, and Secretary in Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) and State Public Service Commissions (PSCs) - are filled through direct recruitment based on eligibility criteria like qualifications, experience, and domain expertise, rather than a written exam. Similarly, some administrative posts in the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) may be filled through direct recruitment.

2. Sports Quota Recruitment

Government organisations such as Indian Railways, the Indian Army, and Public Sector Banks reserve a quota of posts for candidates with outstanding achievements in sports at the state, national, or international level. Eligible candidates can be appointed to posts like Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, and Clerk without going through the regular written exam.

3. Cultural Quota Recruitment

Indian Railways also recruits individuals with exceptional talent in arts, fine arts, music, or literature under the cultural quota for posts such as Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, and Assistant Loco Pilot.

4. Internal Promotions and Deputation

Government departments, including the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) and Indian Police Service (IPS), promote existing employees to higher posts based on performance, seniority, and experience - without requiring them to clear a fresh competitive exam. Ex-servicemen and defence personnel are also often considered for civilian government posts through deputation or reservation quotas, without a written exam.

5. Apprenticeships and Trainee Programmes

Railways, PSUs, and central organisations like DRDO and BEL regularly hire Act Apprentices, Trade Apprentices, and Project Trainees through merit lists based on academic marks - with no written entrance test.

6. Walk-in Interviews

Some government and PSU organisations directly call candidates for walk-in interviews based on their qualifications and experience, especially for technical, medical, and contractual roles.

Government Jobs Without Exam by Sector

This section breaks down no-exam opportunities by sector - banking and railways - which are among the most common areas where such recruitment occurs.

Bank Jobs Without Exam

While most public sector bank recruitment (PO, Clerk, SO) happens through IBPS or bank-specific written exams, some banks fill specific posts - such as Local Bank Officer and certain Specialist Officer roles - through direct recruitment, where the bank shortlists applications based on eligibility criteria and conducts an interview instead of a written test.

Railway Jobs Without Exam

Indian Railways and the various Railway Recruitment Boards/Cells (RRBs/RRCs) offer no-exam entry through:

  • Act Apprentices (selection via academic merit list)
  • Sports Quota posts (Assistant Station Master, Ticket Collector, Clerk)
  • Cultural Quota posts (Junior Clerk, Ticket Collector, Assistant Loco Pilot)
  • Scouts and Guides Quota

Before You Apply: How to Spot Fake "No Exam" Job Offers

No-exam recruitment is the single biggest magnet for job fraud in India, because "direct joining, no exam" is exactly what scammers promise. Four rules protect you:

  1. No genuine government post is ever sold. Nobody - agent, "officer", consultancy - can arrange selection for money. The only payment in real recruitment is the application fee, paid on the official portal, typically a few hundred rupees.
  2. Verify the notification on the official domain. Every real notice lives on a .gov.in, .nic.in or official PSU domain. Every row in our list links to the post page where the official notification PDF and apply link are attached - if an offer you received isn't traceable to an official notice, treat it as fraud.
  3. No recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram DMs. Forwarded "joining letters" and interview calls demanding a deposit are scams, full stop.
  4. Cross-check suspicious notices against PIB Fact Check before sharing or paying anything.

How to Apply for Government Jobs Without Exam

  1. Open the post from the live list and read the official notification PDF - eligibility, age limits and fee are final there, not in any summary.
  2. Confirm you match the qualification and category requirements before paying any fee.
  3. Apply on the official portal linked in the notification; keep the registration number and fee receipt.
  4. For merit-list posts (GDS, apprentice), enter marks exactly as on your certificates - mismatches reject applications at verification.
  5. Track the post page for merit list / shortlist updates, or subscribe to WhatsApp/Telegram alerts so deadlines and results reach you automatically.

Government Jobs Without Exam - FAQs

1. Are there really government jobs without an exam?

Yes. Apprenticeship intakes, India Post GDS, sports and cultural quota posts, walk-in interviews and direct recruitment for experienced candidates are all filled without a written competitive exam. The live list at the top of this page shows every such notification currently open.

2. Which government jobs have no exam and no interview at all?

India Post GDS and Railway/PSU Act Apprentice selections use only a merit list of academic marks - there is no written test and no interview. Everything depends on your Class 10 (and ITI/diploma, where applicable) percentage.

3. What no-exam options exist for freshers after 10th, 12th or ITI?

Apprenticeships, GDS and trainee posts are the main fresher routes. Selection is a merit list prepared from academic marks, which is why these notifications attract very high application volumes despite no exam.

4. Can experienced professionals get a government job without an exam?

Yes. PSUs and autonomous bodies fill officer, manager and specialist posts by shortlisting candidates on qualification and experience, followed by a personal interview - no written test.

5. Are government jobs without exam permanent?

Often not. Apprenticeships are roughly one-year training engagements with a stipend, and many walk-in posts are contractual with fixed tenure. Direct-recruitment posts can be regular - the notification states the nature of each post, so check before applying.

6. Are there bank jobs without an exam?

A few. Some banks fill specialist and local officer posts through shortlisting plus interview. Bank apprenticeship drives vary - some are merit-based while others include an online test - so read each notification's selection clause.

7. Are there railway jobs without an exam?

Yes: Act Apprentice intakes (merit list), sports quota, cultural quota and Scouts & Guides quota. Apprentice intakes are large; the quota routes are small zonal recruitments with their own assessment process.

8. Is India Post GDS really without an exam?

Yes - selection is an online merit list generated from Class 10 marks, with no exam and no interview. Because of that, GDS is heavily targeted by paid-selection scams; apply only through the official GDS portal.

9. How do I identify fake "no exam" job offers?

No genuine government post is sold, fees are paid only on official portals, and no recruitment happens over WhatsApp or Telegram messages. Verify every offer against the official notification on a government or PSU domain - if it isn't there, it's fraud.

10. How often is this list updated?

Daily. New notifications are added as they release, and every listing is removed automatically after its last date, so the list only ever shows posts you can still apply for.

Govt Jobs for Law Graduates - Eligibility (LLB, LLM, BL)

Eligibility varies by post, but the core requirement for almost every government law job is a recognised law degree. Senior and specialised roles add experience, an LLM, or Bar enrolment on top.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor of Law (BL) / LLB (Legum Baccalaureus): the baseline qualification for most legal and law officer posts.
  • LLM (Master of Laws): required for senior legal officer, faculty, and some advisory positions.
  • Integrated 5-year degrees - BA LLB, BBA LLB, BCom LLB - are accepted wherever an LLB is required.

The degree must be from a university recognised by the Bar Council of India.

Bar Council Enrolment & AIBE

For litigation, prosecutor, and standing-counsel roles you generally need to be enrolled as an advocate with a State Bar Council, and many positions ask for the All India Bar Examination (AIBE) Certificate of Practice issued by the Bar Council of India. Purely advisory or research posts (Law Clerk, Research Fellow, Legal Consultant) often do not require enrolment.

Age Limit & Relaxations

The upper age limit is typically 30 to 40 years for the general category, depending on the post and recruiter. Statutory relaxations apply: usually 3 years for OBC, 5 years for SC/ST, and additional relaxation for PwD and ex-servicemen candidates. Always confirm the exact limit and cut-off date in the official notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Salary & Pay Scale for Government Law Jobs

Pay depends on the organisation and grade. Officer-level legal posts under the 7th Pay Commission generally fall in Pay Levels 10 to 12, with a monthly salary roughly between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500, plus Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, and other benefits. PSU legal officers are paid on IDA scales, which can be higher at entry grade.

Types of Law Officer / Legal Posts in Government Sector

  • Judicial Services - Civil Judge (Junior Division), Additional District Judge, High Court Judge, recruited via State Judicial Service Exams (PCS-J)
  • Law Officer / Legal Officer - Roles in public sector banks (IBPS SO Law), insurance companies (LIC AAO Legal), regulatory bodies (SEBI Grade A Legal), and PSUs (Coal India, NTPC, GAIL Legal)
  • Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor - Administrative legal support roles in ministries, universities, and district courts
  • Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO) - Prosecution roles recruited through State PSCs, requiring LLB and often a minimum years of practice

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, ADJ, High Court Judge)

Judicial Services is the most prestigious and highest-paying career path for LLB graduates. Recruitment happens through State Public Service Commissions (e.g., RPSC, UPPSC, MPPSC) via a three-stage exam: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview. Civil Judge posts typically require 0-3 years of practice depending on the state, while some states allow fresh LLB graduates to apply directly.

Law Officer / Legal Officer (Banks, PSU, Insurance)

Public sector banks and insurance companies recruit Law Officers through specialist officer (SO) exams. These posts require only an LLB degree (AIBE not mandatory) and offer competitive pay scales under the 7th Pay Commission equivalent structure, along with allowances.

Legal Assistant & Legal Advisor Posts

These are typically Group B/C administrative-legal posts in ministries, universities, and PSU legal departments, requiring an LLB degree and sometimes relevant drafting/litigation experience.

Assistant Public Prosecutor (APO)

APO recruitment is conducted by State PSCs (e.g., RPSC Assistant Prosecution Officer) and requires an LLB degree, enrollment as an advocate, and in most states, a minimum period of practice (often 3 years).

Selection Process for Law Govt Jobs

The selection process differs by post but commonly includes:

  1. Written examination - testing legal knowledge, aptitude, and general awareness (for judicial services and most exam-based posts).
  2. Interview / viva-voce - assessing legal reasoning and suitability.
  3. Document verification - degree, Bar enrolment, AIBE, age, and category certificates.

Advisory and consultant posts are often filled by shortlisting and interview alone, without a written exam.

What are the latest law govt jobs in 2026?

Current law government jobs in 2026 include Law Officer, Legal Officer, Assistant Prosecution Officer, Judicial Service, and Legal Adviser posts across High Courts, PSUs, public sector banks, and central/state departments. Which departments hire LLB and law graduates?

High Courts and District Courts, the Ministry of Law and Justice, UPSC, State Public Service Commissions, public sector banks, PSUs, insurance companies, and regulatory bodies regularly recruit law graduates for legal and judicial roles.

What is the eligibility for government law jobs?

Most posts require a Bachelor of Law (LLB/BL) from a recognised university; senior roles may require LLM and experience. Litigation and prosecutor posts usually require enrolment with a State Bar Council and, often, the AIBE certificate.

What is the salary of a Law Officer in the government sector?

A government Law Officer or Legal Officer typically earns between ₹56,100 and ₹1,77,500 per month under the 7th Pay Commission, depending on the organisation, plus DA, HRA, and allowances. PSU legal officers draw IDA-scale pay.

Can a fresher LLB graduate get a government job?

Yes. Freshers can apply for Civil Judge (Junior Division) judicial-service exams, Law Clerk and Research Fellow posts in High Courts, and trainee legal roles. Some PSU and bank Law Officer posts require a few years of post-enrolment experience.

How can I apply for law officer vacancies in central government?

Open the post in the table above, read the official notification, register on the recruiter's portal, fill in the application with your LLB and enrolment details, pay the fee, and submit before the last date.

What is the difference between Judicial Services and Law Officer posts

Judicial Services (Civil Judge, via state judiciary exams) places you on the bench as a judge. Law Officer/Legal Officer posts are departmental legal-counsel roles in PSUs, banks, and ministries - advisory and litigation support, recruited by interview or written test.

Is there an age limit for govt law jobs?

Most posts set the upper age at 30 to 40 years for the general category, with statutory relaxations for OBC, SC/ST, and PwD candidates. Check each notification, as judicial-service and PSU limits differ.

Bank of India (BOI), a leading Public Sector Bank with its Head Office in Mumbai, has released a notification for the recruitment of Officers in various Specialist streams up to Scale IV. Under Project No. 2026-27/02 dated 01.08.2026, BOI is inviting applications for 205 vacancies across 48 distinct posts ranging from Officer (Scale I) to Chief Manager (Scale IV). Candidates with qualifications in Computer Science/IT, Law, Fire Engineering, and Civil Engineering can apply online between 10.09.2026 and 25.09.2026.

In brief: BOI is recruiting for IT and specialist officer roles spanning Full-Stack Engineering, Digital Platforms, Information Security, DevSecOps, Data Engineering, Database Administration, Law Officer, Fire Officer, Security Officer, and Civil Engineer, among others. Eligible Indian citizens (and other nationalities specified in the notice) meeting the post-specific qualification and experience criteria as on 01.08.2026 can apply online through the official BOI website. The application mode is online only, and postings will be anywhere in India.

Bank of India Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

Educational qualification is broadly B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc (Computer Science or Information Technology) for the IT and digital-banking posts, LLB for Law Officer, a recognised Fire/Safety Engineering degree for Fire Officer, and a B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering for Civil Engineer. Post-qualification work experience requirements range from 1 year (Scale I) to a minimum of 8 years with domain-specific experience (Scale IV). Each of the 48 posts also carries its own mandatory/preferred professional certifications (examples: OCP Java, CISA/CISM/CISSP, PMP, TOGAF, AWS/Azure certifications, CKA, ITIL) - these are post-specific and detailed in full in Annexure-I to the Notice.

Indian Overseas Bank (IOB) has released a notification for the recruitment of Generalist and Specialist Officers in Various Scales 2026-27 (Advt. No. HRDD/RECT/04/2026-27, dated 28.08.2026). IOB Recruitment 2026 invites applications for 291 vacancies across 14 posts in JMG Scale I, MMG Scale II, and MMG Scale III. IOB Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection is through an Online Examination followed by a Personal Interview.
  • For Post Code 01 (Manager – Branch Management): the Online Examination has 100 questions/100 marks in 2 hours, covering English Language (25Q, 30 minutes) and Professional Knowledge – Banking Law & Practice, Indian Economy & Financial System, Principles & Practices of Banking, Accounting & Financial Management (75Q, 90 minutes).
  • For all other posts: the Online Examination has 100 questions/100 marks in 2 hours, covering English Language (25Q, 30 minutes), General Awareness with special reference to Banking Industry (25Q, 30 minutes), and Professional Knowledge, which varies post-wise (50Q, 60 minutes).
  • There is no minimum qualifying mark for General Awareness and English Language; candidates must secure minimum qualifying marks in Professional Knowledge.
  • Minimum qualifying marks in the Online Examination: 35% for unreserved candidates, 30% for reserved candidates.
  • 1/4th of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for a wrong answer; there is no penalty for unattempted questions.
  • The Interview carries a maximum of 100 marks, assessed on Role-related Industry Exposure, Subject Knowledge, and Communication Skills. Minimum qualifying marks: 50% for unreserved, 45% for reserved candidates.
  • The final merit list is prepared with 80% weightage to the Online Examination and 20% weightage to the Interview.

How to Apply for IOB Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the official IOB website, www.iob.bank.in, and open the "Careers" page.
  2. Click on "Recruitment of Generalist/Specialist Officers in Various Scales – 2026-27" and select the post to be applied for.
  3. Click "Register Online" and complete first-time registration.
  4. Note the system-generated Registration Number and Password sent via e-mail and SMS.
  5. Upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and handwritten declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  6. Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully and click "Complete Registration."
  7. Pay the applicable Application Fee / Intimation Charges online (Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/BHIM/UPI).
  8. Take a printout of the submitted application form and the payment e-receipt for future reference.

IOB Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions

  • Applications can be submitted online only, from 29.08.2026 to 15.09.2026; no other mode will be accepted.
  • Candidates may apply for more than one post, subject to fulfilling the eligibility criteria for each.
  • If a candidate submits multiple applications for the same post, only the last submitted application will be considered.
  • Incomplete applications or those without supporting documents will be rejected outright.
  • OBC candidates must submit a non-creamy layer certificate valid as on the date of interview.
  • The Bank reserves the right to change, modify, cancel, or add to any of the eligibility or selection criteria.
  • Outstation SC/ST/PWBD candidates who are unemployed will be reimbursed second-class train fare by the shortest route, as per Government guidelines.

BOB Local Bank Officer Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must fulfil the following eligibility conditions, assessed as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026, to apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026.

Criteria Details
Nationality Citizen of India, or subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with intent to permanently settle, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from specified countries (Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia, Vietnam) with intent to permanently settle in India

There is no reservation for Ex-Servicemen in the Officers' Cadre; only age relaxation as above applies. OBC candidates in the "creamy layer" are not entitled to OBC reservation or age relaxation.

BOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process

Selection for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 will be based on the following stages:

  • Online Test (multiple sections, described below)
  • Group Discussion (GD) and/or Personal Interview (PI)
  • Psychometric Test and/or any other assessment as deemed suitable by the Bank
  • Local Language Proficiency Test (LPT), where applicable

The tentative structure of the online examination is as follows:

4 Reasoning Ability & Quantitative Aptitude 30 30 30 Minutes
- Total 120 120 120 Minutes

The English Language section is qualifying in nature only, and marks scored in it will not count towards the final merit list. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer. The minimum qualifying marks for GD/PI are 60% for General category and 55% for Reserved category candidates. Candidates must qualify in the Local Language Proficiency Test unless they have studied the local language at the 10th or 12th standard level.

How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026

Eligible candidates can apply online for BOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below.

  1. Visit the official Bank of Baroda website: www.bankofbaroda.bank.in
  2. Go to the Career section/webpage and click on "Current Opportunities".
  3. Register online and fill in the application form for Local Bank Officer.
  4. Upload the required documents, including scanned photograph, signature, resume, DOB proof, educational certificates, work experience certificates, and caste/PWBD certificate (if applicable).
  5. Verify all details carefully before submission, as no changes are allowed after clicking Submit.
  6. Pay the application fee online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI.
  7. Take a printout of the completed application form and fee receipt for future reference.

Age is reckoned as on 1 August 2026. The minimum and maximum age limits vary by post/grade as shown in the vacancy table above:

  • Grade/Scale-II posts (Manager-Credit, Manager-Law, Manager-Risk, Manager-Company Secretary): 25 to 35 years
  • Manager-Security Officer (Scale-II): Not more than 35 years of age
  • Grade/Scale-III posts (Senior Manager-Credit, Forex, Treasury, Law): 25 to 38 years

Bank transaction charges for online payment of the application fee will have to be borne by the candidate. The application fee is non-refundable and will not be refunded even if the application is rejected or not considered by the Bank.

On selection, candidates must execute an Indemnity Bond with two sureties before joining as an Officer. For all cadres (Grade/Scale I, II & III), the bond amount is Rs. 3.00 Lakhs for a bond period of 2 years. If a candidate resigns, leaves, or abandons service before completing the specified period, they must indemnify the Bank for the bond costs, charges, and expenses incurred.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Selection Process 2026

Selection is based on an Online Written Test followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates who qualify in the online written test will be called for interview, and final selection will be based on performance in both the written test and interview, subject to the candidate being found medically fit for the assignment.

How to Apply for Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only from 15 August 2026 to 7 September 2026; no other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Go to the "Career" section of the Bank's website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in, click "Current Openings" under the Recruitment tab, and click "Apply Online".
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID. Note down the system-generated Provisional Registration Number and Password (also sent by Email/SMS).
  3. Use the "Save and Next" facility to fill the form in stages if required, and verify details carefully before final submission.
  4. Upload your scanned Photograph and Signature as per the specifications given in the notification (Photograph: 4.5cm × 3.5cm, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB; Signature: 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB).
  5. Upload your scanned Left Thumb Impression (240×240 pixels, 200 DPI, 20–50 KB) and a handwritten declaration in English on white paper with black ink (800×400 pixels, 200 DPI, 50–100 KB) - text: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required."
  6. Fill in all remaining details of the application form and click the Preview tab to verify the entire form before Complete Registration.
  7. Click "Complete Registration" only after confirming that the photograph, signature, and all details are correct, since no changes are possible thereafter.
  8. Click the "Payment" tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1,500 (including GST) through the available online payment modes.
  9. Click "Submit" and take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

All particulars mentioned in the online application - Name, Category, Date of Birth, Address, Mobile Number, Email ID, Centre of Examination, etc. - are considered final; no change or modification is allowed after submission.

Nainital Bank Specialist Officer Important Instructions

  • Signature and the handwritten declaration must be in the candidate's own handwriting and in English only; signatures in CAPITAL LETTERS will not be accepted.
  • Photograph must be a recent passport-style colour picture against a light/white background, without caps, hats, or dark glasses (religious headwear allowed if it does not cover the face).
  • Candidates must produce, in original, a currently valid photo ID proof (PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving License, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Aadhaar/e-Aadhaar, Employee ID, Bar Council ID, etc.) along with a photocopy at the examination and interview. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are NOT valid ID proof.
  • The name on the call letter must exactly match the name on the photo ID proof; candidates who have changed their name (e.g., after marriage) must carry the original Gazette notification/marriage certificate/affidavit.
  • Candidates found with an unclear/blurred photo or signature in capital letters on the admit card will not be allowed to appear for the exam.
  • Mobile phones or similar electronic communication devices are strictly prohibited in the examination/interview hall.
  • A candidate is allowed to appear only once in the online examination for a post; multiple appearances will result in cancellation of candidature.
  • Guidelines for scribe/compensatory time are provided for visually impaired candidates and candidates with locomotor disability/cerebral palsy or other specified disabilities under the RPWD Act, 2016, with prescribed certificates (Appendix-I) and undertakings (Appendix-II) as detailed in the official notification.
  • The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances and will not be held in reserve for any future examination or selection.

How to Download SBI SCO Law Officer Admit Card 2026

  1. Visit the official SBI website at sbi.bank.in.
  2. Click on "Join SBI" and then select "Current Openings" from the homepage.

The State Bank of India (SBI) has released the notification for recruitment of Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales) under a Special Recruitment Drive for SC/ST/OBC Backlog Vacancies (Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16). Online registration is open from 7 August 2026 to 27 August 2026. This article explains the exam pattern for Prelims and Mains, the Local Language Proficiency Test, marking scheme, and selection process exactly as given in the official notification.

Note on syllabus: The official notification specifies the names of the test sections, number of questions, marks, and duration for each phase, but it does not publish a topic-wise syllabus. Wherever this article lists sub-topics for a section, it is clearly marked as a general guide and not an officially notified syllabus. If a detail is not available in the notification, this article states that explicitly instead of assuming it.

SBI Junior Associate Exam Pattern 2026

The selection process has three stages: Preliminary Examination, Main Examination, and (where applicable) a Local Language Proficiency Test. Both online tests carry negative marking of 1/4th mark for every wrong answer.

Phase I: Preliminary Examination Pattern

The Prelims is an objective test of 100 marks and 1 hour total duration, split into three separately timed sections. There is no sectional cut-off, but the Bank shortlists candidates for Mains based on aggregate marks (approximately 10 times the number of vacancies per category, subject to availability).

S.No. Test Name Medium of Exam No. of Questions Max. Marks Duration
1 English Language English 30 30 20 minutes
2 Numerical Ability English/Hindi (as per state) 35 35 20 minutes
3 Reasoning Ability English/Hindi (as per state) 35 35 20 minutes
Total 100 100 1 Hour

Phase II: Main Examination Pattern

The Main Exam is an objective test of 200 marks over 2 hours 40 minutes, with four separately timed sections. Only the aggregate marks obtained in the Main Examination are used to prepare the final merit list Prelims marks are not added at this stage.

S.No. Test Name Medium of Exam No. of Questions Max. Marks Duration
1 General/Financial Awareness English/Hindi (as per state) 50 50 35 minutes
2 General English English 40 40 35 minutes
3 Quantitative Aptitude English/Hindi (as per state) 50 50 45 minutes
4 Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude English/Hindi (as per state) 50 60 45 minutes
Total 190 200 2 Hr. 40 min.

Candidates must score minimum qualifying marks on aggregate, as decided by the Bank; there are no individual sectional qualifying marks, and sectional marks are not maintained separately.

Phase III: Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT)

Provisionally selected candidates who have not studied the specified local language of the applied state in Class 10 or 12 must appear for the LLPT after Main Exam qualification but before joining. Candidates who submit a 10th/12th mark sheet showing the local language as a subject are exempted from this test.

S.No. Test Pattern Section No. of Passages No. of Questions Max. Marks
1 Non-Verbal Test Objective 3 15 15
1 Non-Verbal Test Subjective 3 15 15
2 Verbal Test - - 20

Candidates who fail to qualify the LLPT will not be offered appointment.

SBI Junior Associate Syllabus 2026 (Section-wise Guide)

The notification does not release a detailed, topic-wise syllabus it only names the test sections shown above. Based on the officially named sections, the following are the broad areas typically covered under each section for this kind of clerical-cadre banking exam. Treat this as a general study guide, not an official syllabus document.

Prelims Sections

  • English Language: Reading comprehension, cloze test, para jumbles, error detection, fill in the blanks, vocabulary-based questions.
  • Numerical Ability: Simplification, number series, quadratic equations, data interpretation, arithmetic problems (percentage, profit & loss, average, ratio, time & work, simple/compound interest).
  • Reasoning Ability: Puzzles, seating arrangement, syllogism, inequality, coding-decoding, blood relations, direction sense, alphanumeric series.

Mains Sections

  • General/Financial Awareness: Current affairs, banking and financial awareness, static general knowledge.
  • General English: Comprehension, grammar, vocabulary, sentence correction, and para-based questions at a slightly higher difficulty than Prelims.
  • Quantitative Aptitude: Data interpretation, data sufficiency, arithmetic word problems, number series, simplification/approximation.
  • Reasoning Ability & Computer Aptitude: Advanced puzzles and seating arrangement, logical reasoning, plus basic computer knowledge (fundamentals, MS Office, internet, and banking-related computer terms).

How to Apply

  • Visit the official SBI careers page: https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings
  • Locate and open the "Special Recruitment drive for Junior Associates 2026" link.
  • Download and carefully read Advertisement No. CRPD/CR/SPLDRIVE/2026-27/16.
  • Register online with a valid email ID and mobile number.
  • Fill in the application form and upload the scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression, and hand-written declaration.
  • Pay the application fee (if applicable) using debit card, credit card, or internet banking.
  • Submit the form and save/print the system-generated application form for your records (this printout is not to be sent to SBI).

Important Instructions

  • Candidates can apply for vacancies in one State/UT only and can appear for the test only once under this recruitment project.
  • There is no provision for Inter-Circle or Inter-State transfer, except intra-state transfer between Delhi Circle & Lucknow Circle (Uttar Pradesh) and between Mumbai Metro Circle & Maharashtra Circle (Maharashtra), subject to the Bank's extant guidelines.
  • No changes or corrections to submitted application particulars, including category, will be entertained under any circumstances.
  • Mobile phones, smartwatches, calculators, and similar devices are strictly prohibited inside the examination premises.
  • A wait list of up to 50% of vacancies (state-category wise) will be maintained and released quarterly, valid for one year from the date of declaration of the final result.
  • SBI reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process entirely at any stage.
  • SBI has clarified it does not endorse any external coaching platform or consultancy claiming to guarantee selection; candidates should rely only on the official career portal.

MT/MIS B.Tech/BE (Computer Engineering/Computer Science) or MCA or M.Sc(IT)/M.Sc (Computer Science) or DOEACC B Level, min. 60% marks, from a Govt-approved/AICTE-UGC recognised institution.

Assistant Officer Posts

Post Educational Qualification & Experience
AO/CO (Commercial & Operations) Graduate with min. 50% marks, plus 4 years' experience (OR 2 years' if the candidate holds an Institute of Rail Transport Diploma in multimodal transport, or any other minimum 1-year special course in shipping/logistics/trade, in addition to the above qualification).
AO/FA (Accounts) B.Com with min. 50% marks, plus 4 years' experience (OR 2 years' for candidates who have qualified CA (Inter)/CMA (Inter) in addition to the above qualification).
AO/TH (Technical) Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Electronics, min. 50% marks, plus 3 years' experience for diploma holders (OR 1 year for candidates with a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering – Mechanical/Electrical/Civil/Electronics – min. 50% aggregate).

Important: The listed qualification is the minimum required. A candidate with a higher qualification is eligible only if they also possess the specific prescribed qualification – mere possession of a higher qualification without the minimum prescribed one does not make a candidate eligible. It is mandatory for all posts that the candidate is conversant with working in a computerized environment.

CONCOR Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

Post Group Age Limit (UR, as on 31.08.2026)

Assistant Officer (all disciplines) 18–32 years

Age Relaxation

Category Relaxation
SC / ST 5 years
OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 3 years
Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) 10 years
Ex-servicemen (ESM) 3 years plus period of service
Departmental candidates 5 years
Note: Maximum upper age of an applicant, including all possible age relaxations, must not exceed 50 years. Age concession to PwBD candidates is admissible irrespective of whether the specific post is reserved for PwBD. Ex-servicemen already in regular Central/State Government/CPSE/Autonomous Body employment get age relaxation for another post but are not eligible for the reservation benefit.

CONCOR Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale & CTC

Post Pay Scale Approx. CTC (Per Annum)
Management Trainee (all disciplines) ₹50,000-3%-1,60,000 ₹20.11 Lakhs
Assistant Officer (all disciplines) ₹40,000-3%-1,36,000 ₹16.09 Lakhs
Management Trainees undergo one year of on-the-job and off-the-job training and, on successful completion, are absorbed in the Assistant Manager grade/E1. Selected MT candidates must execute a service bond of ₹2 Lakhs plus 12% interest per annum, to serve CONCOR for a minimum of three years (excluding the training period).

CONCOR Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Management Trainee: Computer Based Test (CBT), followed by Group Discussion and/or Interview, as decided by CONCOR. CONCOR's decision is final and binding.
  • Assistant Officer: Selection is purely based on performance in the Online Test (CBT) – there is no GD or interview stage for this post.
  • No correspondence will be entertained for non-calling of a candidate for the Online Test/GD/Interview, or for non-selection.

CBT Exam Pattern (MT & AO)

Section No. of Questions Max. Marks
Professional Knowledge 50 50
English Language 10 10
Reasoning 10 10
Quantitative Aptitude 15 15
General Knowledge 15 15
Total 100 100
  • Duration: 90 minutes total (120 minutes for eligible PwBD candidates availing a scribe).
  • Negative marking: 1/4 (0.25) mark deducted for each wrong answer.
  • Each question has 5 answer choices.
  • The question paper is set in English and Hindi only; the English version prevails in case of any discrepancy.
  • Candidates opt for 3 Test Cities in order of preference at the time of application; this cannot be changed after submission. CONCOR reserves the right to cancel or add examination centres at its discretion.

How to Apply for CONCOR Recruitment 2026

  1. Visit the CONCOR website concorindia.co.in and go to 'HR & Career Section → Recruitment and Result'.
  2. Before starting, keep a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number ready and active till the process completes – create a new e-mail ID first if you don't have one.
  3. Fill in the online application form as per the instructions provided on the portal and pay the applicable fee online.
  4. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application form with the prescribed fee for each post code.
  5. Submit the application by 30 September 2026, 11:55 PM. No other mode of application (offline/postal) is accepted.
  6. Registration number, password, e-Admit Card, Call Letter for Document Verification/GD/Interview and other communication will be sent only to the registered e-mail ID/SMS – check your spam/junk folder as well.
Important: Applications received without the prescribed fee, required documents and information are liable to be rejected. Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any future recruitment.

Application Fee & Documents Required

Category Fee for MT Fee for AO
General (UR) / OBC (Creamy & Non-Creamy Layer) / EWS ₹750 + GST ₹500 + GST
SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-servicemen Exempted – no fee payable

Fee is accepted online only; bank transaction/intimation charges are borne by the candidate. Documents to be produced in original at the time of document verification (for candidates who qualify the CBT) include:

  • All educational qualification certificates and mark sheets (final mark sheet/degree, if provisionally applied while in the final year/semester)
  • Caste certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL, in the prescribed proforma; OBC-NCL certificate not older than 1 year)
  • Disability certificate from the Competent Authority, for PwBD reservation/relaxation (40% or more disability)
  • Income and Asset Certificate, not older than 1 year, for EWS reservation
  • Defence Service Certificate from the Competent Authority, for Ex-servicemen candidates
  • No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer, for candidates already employed on a regular basis in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Autonomous Bodies
  • A notarized English or Hindi translation, if any SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/EWS certificate is issued in another language

Important Conditions

  • CONCOR does not undertake detailed scrutiny of eligibility at the application/CBT stage – candidature is accepted only provisionally; candidates must satisfy themselves of their eligibility before applying.
  • If claims of qualification/caste/category made in the application are not substantiated by documents at verification, the candidature will be cancelled; furnishing wrong or false information, or suppressing information, leads to disqualification and, even if appointed, termination of service.
  • If the candidate's identity is in doubt, or requisite documents cannot be produced, or there is a mismatch in document information, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for Document Verification and the candidature is liable to be cancelled.
  • Selected candidates are liable to be posted at any office/terminal/unit of CONCOR at any location, at the company's sole discretion, and liable to transfer anywhere thereafter.
  • If marks in the qualifying exam are in CGPA terms, they should not be lower than 7 points on a 10-point scale, or the equivalent percentage, and not less than the prescribed percentage for the respective post.
  • Where a Management/Engineering qualification has dual specialization, one specialization must be function-specific to the post advertised.
  • Experience requirements must be in the areas specified in the post's job specification; there is no experience requirement for ex-servicemen candidates.
  • No travelling expenses are paid for the online test or Group Discussion; candidates appearing for interview get travel expense reimbursement as per CONCOR's TA/DA rules.
  • Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate.
  • Appointment is subject to verification of original documents (age, qualification, experience, caste), police verification, reference checks, and fitness in the Medical Fitness Test conducted by CONCOR's Medical Authorities.
  • Management has the right to cancel the recruitment at any point without notice, and the number of posts may increase or decrease at CONCOR's sole discretion.
  • In case of any ambiguity from interpretation in a version other than English, the English version prevails. Any dispute regarding this recruitment will be settled within the jurisdiction of Delhi only.

RRB Group D Application Status 2026: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) have issued a revised notice on the application status for CEN No. 09/2025 (Level-1) recruitment. Candidates can now check their updated application status provisionally accepted, conditionally accepted, or rejected by logging in at www.rrbapply.gov.in. The revised status is being updated from August 9, 2026, at 9:00 PM (21:00 Hrs) onward.

RRB Group D Application Status 2026 - Overview

Particulars Details
Recruitment RRB Group D (Level-1 posts)
CEN Number CEN No. 09/2025
Conducting Body Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB), Ministry of Railways
Notice Type Revised Notice on Application Status
Original Status Notice Issued July 8, 2026
Revised Status Available From August 9, 2026, 9:00 PM
Status Check Website www.rrbapply.gov.in
Status Categories Provisionally Accepted, Conditionally Accepted (with conditions), Rejected (with reasons)
Notification Date August 9, 2026

RRB Group D Application Status: Categories Explained

Candidates can now view their updated status under three categories:

  • Provisionally Accepted: The application has been accepted on a provisional basis. It is not a final confirmation, and RRB can still cancel the candidature at any later stage if any discrepancy is found.
  • Conditionally Accepted: The application has been accepted subject to certain conditions. Candidates must check the specific conditions mentioned against their application and follow RRB's instructions.
  • Rejected: The application has been rejected, and the reason for rejection will be shown along with the status.

Also Read: RRB Group D Admit Card 2026

How to Check RRB Group D Application Status 2026

  1. Visit the official RRB application portal: www.rrbapply.gov.in.
  2. Log in using your registered user credentials.
  3. Navigate to the application status section for CEN No. 09/2025.
  4. View your status: Provisionally Accepted, Conditionally Accepted, or Rejected.
  5. If rejected, check the reason for rejection displayed against your application.
  6. Save or take a screenshot of the status page for future reference.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • The list of provisionally eligible candidates has been prepared carefully, but RRB reserves the right to rectify any inadvertent error or typographical/printing mistake.
  • RRB will not entertain any correspondence from ineligible or rejected candidates.
  • Candidature of all eligible/accepted candidates is purely provisional and can be cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process or even afterward if any inconsistency, deficiency, falsified record, or malpractice is found.
  • Candidates should refer only to official RRB websites for recruitment updates and must not rely on unauthenticated sources.
  • RRB has warned candidates to stay alert against touts who make false promises of selection in exchange for illegal consideration. The RRB recruitment process is fully computerized, and selection is based purely on merit.

Also Read: RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026

What to Do After Checking Your Status

If your application shows as provisionally or conditionally accepted, continue preparing for the next stage of the CEN 09/2025 recruitment process as and when RRB announces it. If your application is rejected, review the stated reason; RRB has clarified that it will not respond to correspondence from rejected candidates on this matter.

How to Download the RRB Group D City Intimation Slip 2026

  • Cross-check the exam city, date, and shift carefully, since errors should be reported to RRB through official channels as soon as possible.

How to Calculate Your Score Using the CIL MT Answer Key

The test was conducted for candidates from the outside-Karnataka and Kalyana-Karnataka quota applying to Village Administrative Officer (VAO), Land Surveyor, KREIS Teacher, Armed Police Constable (CAR/DAR/KSRP/IRB/KSISF), and Karnataka State Legal Services Authority (KSLSA) Section Officer posts who have not studied or passed their qualifying examination in Kannada.

The key answer has been published on the official KEA website, covering all four question paper versions A1, B1, C1, and D1. Candidates can now match their responses against the official key to estimate their probable score ahead of the final result. This article covers the download link, objection process, important dates, and answers to the questions candidates are asking most.

KEA Kannada Language Test 2026 What It Is

The Compulsory Kannada Language Test is a qualifying test, not a merit-ranking exam. It applies only to candidates from the outside-Karnataka and Kalyana-Karnataka quota who have not studied or passed their qualifying examination in Kannada, or who have not cleared an equivalent Kannada test, or who have not completed SSLC-level schooling with Kannada as a first or second language. Clearing this test alone does not guarantee final selection it is a mandatory clearance step for the candidates it applies to. The 22nd August 2026 sitting covered candidates applying for the following posts:

  • Police Department CAR/DAR/KSRP/IRB/KSISF Constable posts
  • Revenue Department Village Administrative Officer (VAO)
  • Land Surveyor posts (Department of Survey Settlement and Land Records)
  • Teacher posts under Karnataka Residential Education Institutions Society (KREIS)
  • Section Officer posts under the Karnataka State Legal Services Authority

  4. The answer key will display version-wise A1, B1, C1, and D1 on the screen.
  5. Match the answers against your version code and marked responses.
  6. Download and save the PDF for future reference and for use during objection filing.

KEA Kannada Language Test 2026 Objection Process

Candidates who wish to challenge any answer in the provisional key can do so through the official KEA Provisional Answer Key Objection Portal. The window is open from 22nd August 2026 until 24th August 2026, 12:00 noon, after which no objections will be accepted.

Steps to Raise an Objection

  1. Visit the objection portal login page at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/keaobjections.
  2. Log in using your Application Number/Register Number and the first 5 characters of your name.
  3. Enter your Date of Birth.
  4. Select the examination Compulsory Kannada – 2026 (22-08-2026).
  5. Enter the captcha code and log in.
  6. Select the question number and version code you want to object to.
  7. Upload supporting documents or proof in PDF format for each objection.
  8. Pay the applicable fee of Rs. 25/- per objection and submit.

Important Instructions

  • Every objection must clearly mention the question number and version code, and must be supported by valid proof in PDF format.
  • A fee of Rs. 25/- is charged per objection raised; this fee is non-refundable.
  • Objections that do not correctly mention the question number or version code, or that lack valid supporting proof, will not be considered.
  • The decision of the subject expert committee reviewing the objections will be treated as final.
  • Objections cannot be submitted after 24th August 2026, 12:00 noon.

Also Read: HTET Result 2026

What Happens After the Objection Window Closes

Once the objection window closes on 24th August 2026, the subject expert committee will review all objections submitted by candidates. Based on this review, KEA will release the final answer key for the Kannada Language Test. Results will then be prepared using the final key, feeding into the overall selection process for the respective posts Police Constable, Village Administrative Officer, Land Surveyor, KREIS Teacher, and Section Officer. The exact date for the final key and result has not been officially announced yet.

About UPSC Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination 2026

The ISS Examination is one of the premier competitive exams conducted by UPSC to recruit officers for Group A and Group B posts in the Indian Statistical Service. Understanding the exam structure helps candidates correctly interpret the provisional answer key.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. The exam tests candidates on subjects including Statistics, General English, and General Studies. The Statistics papers are the most technical and weightage-heavy components of the exam. The provisional answer key released covers the objective/multiple-choice components of the Statistics papers.

ISS Examination Paper Structure

The ISS Examination 2026 Statistics papers for which the provisional answer key has been released are:

  • Statistics Paper I - Covers topics such as Probability, Statistical Methods, Numerical Analysis, and related areas.
  • Statistics Paper II - Covers topics including Linear Models, Statistical Inference, Sampling Theory, and Econometrics.

How to Raise Objections Against UPSC ISS Provisional Answer Key 2026

If a candidate disagrees with any answer published in the provisional answer key, they can submit a formal representation to UPSC within the stipulated objection window period.

UPSC allows candidates to challenge answers in the provisional answer key by submitting a formal representation. The process for raising objections is as follows:

  • Download the provisional answer key PDF for the relevant paper.
  • Identify the question number(s) where you believe the answer is incorrect.
  • Prepare a written representation with supporting references from standard textbooks or study material.
  • Submit the representation to UPSC through the official channel specified in the answer key notification (typically by post or online submission to the UPSC office).
  • UPSC will review all representations received before publishing the Final Answer Key.

What Happens After the Provisional Answer Key?

After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

Everything on this list is inside your control. 2. 150 calls a day. The one hard number. 3. Talk time. Calls ending in eleven seconds don't count for much. 4. Call quality. Reviewed from recordings- did you ask, listen, and advise honestly? 5. Follow-up adherence. Every open lead contacted on schedule. 6. CRM hygiene. Logged same day, every day. 7. Conversions, site visits, and partner activations are tracked- but they're the company's scoreboard, not a quota over your head. Who fits: 1. Fluent Hindi and working English. 2. Comfortable dialling all day- reads a room over the phone. 3. Writes a clean CRM note. 4. Prior experience in real estate, interiors, edtech, or any high-volume inside sales floor is an advantage, not a requirement.

A little bit about us

Here at Wellburn, our lovely family run business operates a little differently to a lot of other businesses. We don't hire robots. We hire people. Everyone is different, and we love that. Our recruitment policy is as much to do with personality as it is about qualifications. We need you to fit in and be part of the team. Part of the family.


About the role

The Handyperson is key to the welfare of our residents at Wellburn Care by ensuring high standards of general maintenance to the care home and surrounding areas. We are looking for a handyperson who are self-motivated and can prioritise their own workload with a good general knowledge of all aspects of maintenance including basic plumbing, joinery, and household electrical fittings.

Our Handyperson will have a keen eye to identify general maintenance work that is required to keep our homes safe and as comfortable as possible for the residents. You will be responsible for all minor repairs within the home as well as reporting defects, undertaking Health and Safety checks (training will be given) and maintaining the appropriate records.

Sounding good? We want to hear from you!

Apply

If you like what you read simply click the apply button, enter some quick details and submit your CV. It really couldn't be easier. Click submit and leave the rest to us. We'll then get back in touch with you as soon as possible - usually within three working days.

Role Snapshot
Description Trant Te-Tech design, custom build and install a wide range of high quality control panels, motor control centres (MCCs) and automation systems, offering conventional, intelligent and withdrawable systems with outstanding reliability and functionality.
We are currently looking for a proven Wireperson to join our workshop based near Totton, Southampton.

The Role The Wire Person is responsible for the accurate assembly and wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems in accordance with electrical drawings, specifications, and applicable standards. The role plays a key part in ensuring assemblies meet quality, safety, and compliance requirements prior to inspection and testing.What Youll Be DoingTechnical Responsibilities - Panel & MCC Wiring
  • Carry out wiring of control panels, MCCs, and automation systems to approved schematics and wiring diagrams.
  • Install and terminate power, control, and instrumentation cabling.
  • Assemble and wire MCCs and control panels.
  • Ensure correct segregation, routing and termination in line with design and compliance requirements.
Technical Support & Collaboration
  • Accurately interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, BOMs, and general arrangement drawings.
  • Mark up drawings where required to reflect as-built changes.
  • Follow work instructions and build documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with fellow wire-people, testers, and supervisors to meet production targets.
  • Support improvements in wiring practices, layout, and efficiency.
  • Provide feedback to supervisors on build issues or potential improvements.
SHE&Q and Compliance
  • Carry out self-checks and peer checks prior to formal testing.
  • Identify and report defects, non-conformances or drawing discrepancies.
  • Work safely in accordance with company H&S procedures and UK legislation.
  • Maintain a clean, tidy and organised working area.
  • Use tools, equipment, and PPE correctly at all times.
Key Interfaces:
Internal Interfaces
  • Workshop Supervisor.
  • Production Manager.
  • Test Engineer.
  • Design & Engineering Teams.
  • Automation Team.
  • Stores / Logistic.
  • Quality Team.
External Interfaces
  • Clients / Inspectors (as required)
  • Suppliers (limited)
Core Values

Uphold and promote the Companys Core Values Care, Trust, Respect and Sustainability.

What Were Looking ForEssential
  • NVQ Level 3 (or equivalent) in Electrical Installation, Panel Wiring, or Electrical Engineering.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and GA drawings.
  • Working knowledge of electrical safety practices and workshop H&S requirements.
  • Familiarity with quality-controlled manufacturing processes.
  • Proven experience wiring control panels, MCCs, or similar electrical assemblies.
  • Experience terminating power, control, and instrumentation wiring.
  • Experience working from schematics, wiring schedules, and BOMs.
  • Experience completing work to high quality and safety standards in a workshop environment.
  • Applicants must be legally authorised to work in the UK, as we are unable to sponsor work visas for this role.
Desirable
  • 18th Edition (BS 7671) qualification.
  • Awareness or training relating to BS EN 61439-2:2021.
  • Manufacturer or industry training on MCCs, switchgear andautomation systems.
  • First Aid or IOSH Working Safely certification.
  • Experience wiring MCCs and control panels.
  • Experience with PLC I/O wiring, automation panels, and instrumentation.
  • Experience supporting test and inspection activities, including rectification of faults.
  • Experience working on custom-built, client-specific panel builds.
Why Join Trant ?At Trant Engineering, we deliver complex, high-value engineering and construction projects across the UK. From process and water treatment to energy infrastructure upgrades, we play a key role in delivering and protecting critical national infrastructure shaping the systems that communities and industries rely on every day.

Our teams design and deliver full EPC solutions, combining technical excellence with practical, hands-on delivery. We offer end-to-end capabilities from concept and design through to manufacturing, construction and commissioning utilising a continually evolving in-house expertise. This means youll work on projects that are varied, challenging and genuinely impactful.

Our multi-disciplinary teams bring together specialists in civil, mechanical, electrical, process, instrumentation, and control & automation engineering, alongside our in-house manufacturing of control panels, MCCs, PLCs and SCADA systems. With over 1,000 people and a strong, growing pipeline of work, its an exciting time to join Trant. We are committed to helping our people succeed through our Career Development Association, providing structured support, mentoring and clear pathways to help you reach your full potential.

Whether youre starting out or looking to take your next career step, Trant offers the chance to develop, progress and make a real difference.

Our company benefits package includes:
  • Competitive rates.
  • 28 days holiday (including bank holidays).
  • Options to buy additional holiday via salary sacrifice.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Employee assistance program.
  • Discretionary annual bonus.
Join us and be part of something bigger.
